tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs/

rgya gar skad du/ ma hā yā na u pa de sha shāst+ra tsintā ratna ko ṣa nā ma/ bod skad du/ theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje'i mkha' dbyings 'od gsal dag pa la/ /mkhyen brtse'i dkyil 'khor gang bas mdzes byas shing*/ /mtha' yas skye dgu'i 'dod ster rol pa can/ /phan bde'i 'od stong 'phro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skal bzang rnams kyis don du gnyer bya ba/ /thar pa'i mchog ste de nyid sgrub pa'i thabs/ /kun gyi nang nas rtse mor gyur pa zhig /deng sang bdag gis rab tu gsal bar bya/ / thog ma'i 'od gsal bde gshegs snying po nyid/ /don gyi kun gzhi rang bzhin 'dus ma byas/ /ye nas rnam dag nyi mkha' lta bu las/ /ma rig kun brtags glo bur sgrib pa'i sprin/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i bag la nyal langs pas/ /yul dang don dang lus su bag chags te/ /rig pa'i rang bzhin 'od gsal snying po bsgribs/ /ji ltar sprin gyis mkha' dbyings nyi bsgribs bzhin/ /yon tan mi mngon 'khrul snang bde sdug snang*/ sprin las char byung lo tog 'phel ba bzhin/ / ma rig gzung 'dzin sems sprin rab g.yos pas/ /dge sdig las kyi char babs des bskyed pa'i/ /'bras bu khams gsum 'khor ba'i rang bzhin no/ / 'khrul snang ji snyed bag chags gsum nyid las/ / yul gyi bag chags snod kyi 'jig rten dang / /de la brten pa'i gzugs sogs yul lnga'o/ /don gyi bag chags rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang*/ /de la brten pa'i dge sdig las rnams so/ /lus kyi bag chags 'gro drug so so'i gzugs/ /de la brten pa'i yan lag nying lag go /de ltar kun gzhi'i steng du bag chags gsum/ /thog med dus nas bzhag pa de goms pas/ /tshe rabs kun du de ltar snang ba yin/ /mi shes pa dag thams cad sems yin lo/ /snang ba rnam gsum don la shin tu rmongs/

/skyon mang phan tshun 'chol zhing ha cang thal/ /skyong byed dag gi lugs ngan de spongs shig /'di ltar yul las gzung ba'i rnam rtog dang*/ /don las 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog rnam gnyis skye/ /de las nyon mongs gzeb dang rten byed de/ /mi mkhas bden par zhen pas rtag tu 'khor/ /'di dag thams cad don la med na yang*/ /gzung 'dzin dbang gis rten 'brel sgyu mar snang*/ /ji srid gzung 'dzin dbyings su ma nub par/ /rgyu 'bras las yod de yis sprul pa ste/ /sems kyis 'du byed sems kyis las kun byed/ /sems la snang zhing sems kyis brtags pas na/ /'khrul pa'i sems gdul slad du 'bad par mdzod/ /ji ltar dha du ra yis myos pa la/ /sna tshogs snang ba mi 'dra ci shar yang*/ /thams cad 'khrul pa'i gzugs te don la med/ /de bzhin sems 'khrul pa yis sbyar ba yi/ /'gro drug 'khrul snang ma lus ji snyed kun/ / med snang stong pa'i gzugs brnyan shes par mdzod/ /de ltar 'khor ba'i rang bzhin gzugs brnyan bzhin/ thog ma gang las byung ba brtag par gyis/ /de yis mya ngan 'das pa'i rang bzhin shes/ /srid las rnam grol bde gshegs dbang por 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ gzhi las 'khor ba'i grub tshul bstan pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// // de ltar khams gsum 'khor bar snang ba na/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rjes zhing khams rnam bkod de/ /'gro ba'i don kun sgrub la nor bu bzhin/ /srid nas zhi bar rab tu 'dren par mdzad/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas sems can zhing rnams su/ /dus gsum rgyal bas don chen mdzad pa las/ /zhing 'di'i ston pas ji ltar 'dul ba'i tshul/ /re zhig bsdus te rab tu bstan pa ni/ /ston pa yid bzhin kun tu bzang po nyid/ /thog ma med pa'i dus su byang chub nas/ /chos sku'i ngang las longs skur lhun grub ste/ /thugs gsung sku yi sems dpa' gsum sprul nas/

/'gro drug gnas su sems can don mdzad cing*/ /dus ring thog mtha' med par bzhugs pa las/ /khyad par mi mjed 'jig rten don mdzad pa/ /chos sku'i dbyings nas stug po bkod pa'i zhing*/ /rang snang 'od gsal rnam lnga'i 'od spros pas/ /rin chen padma'i snying pos brgyan pa'i zhing*/ / longs spyod rdzogs skus nye bar brten pa ni/ /gzhi dang snying po me tog brgyan pa ste/ /mi mjed 'bum phrag bcu yi rdul phran dang*/ /grangs mnyam zhing gis zhing der brgyan pa'o/ /de na rnam par snang mdzad gangs chen mtsho'i/ /skyil krung gcig gis pad sdong khebs par bzhugs/ /de yi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas/ /spos chu'i rgyun 'bab de steng sangs rgyas zhing*/ /grangs med brjod 'das bkod pas don mdzad cing*/ /mnyam gzhag steng na spos chu'i rgya mtsho las/ / pad sdong rgya chen ze'u 'bru dpag yas steng*/ /re re bzhin yang zhing khams dpag med gnas/ /khyad par ze'u 'bru dbus ma'i steng nyid na/ /stong gsum nyi shu rtsa lnga brtsegs ma ste/ /phan tshun grangs med za 'og ber khyim bzhin/ / dang po dpal 'byung 'od zer rnam snang zhing*/ /gnyis pa pad mo dpal gyis brgyan pa ste/ /gsum pa rin chen brgyan snang bkod pa'i zhing*/ /bzhi pa me tog sil ma bkram pa ste/ /lnga pa dge ba sna tshogs dag pa'i zhing*/ /drug pa me tog shin tu rgyas pa'i zhing*/ /bdun pa yang dag 'byung ba'i gzi brjid dbyangs/ /brgyad pa sgra dbyangs mi zad sgrog pa'i zhing*/ /dgu pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan bcu pa ni/ /rnam par snang yin bcu gcig snang ba'i mdog /bcu gnyis pa ni rnam snang dang ba'i zhing*/ /bcu gsum mi mjed 'jig rten khams 'di yi/ /shar na khebs ldan lho na rtag pa dang*/ /nub na rdul bral byang na yongs dga'i zhing*/ /steng na 'od 'phro dri med bcu bzhi pa/ /bco lnga pa ni rin chen brgyan pa'i zhing*/ /bcu drug rdul bral bcu bdun dag par snang*/

/bco brgyad rin chen 'od 'phro bcu dgu pa/ / rab snang snang byed de bzhin nyi shu pa/ /'od byed 'od 'phro nyi shu gcig gnyis te/ /snang ldan rab mdzes nyi shu gsum bzhi yin/ /nyi shu lnga pa rab tu dga' ba'i zhing*/ /de ltar lnga tshan rnam lnga'i rang bzhin yang*/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las te/ /sku yi sku sogs zhing khams nyi shu lnga/ /mi mjed thugs kyi thugs te khyad par zhing*/ /gsang chen tshe gcig nges pa'i snying pos brgyan/ /de ltar longs sku'i gzhir gnas zhing rnams su/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa rnam snang chen po yi/ /sprul pas 'dul byed ston pa so sor snang*/ /khyad par stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten 'dir/ /sangs rgyas stong gi sgron ma rnam par bkod/ /rang bzhin gcig nyid de ltar snang ba yin/ / thun mong mdo las yul 'khor skyong gi bu/ /stong rnams so sor sems bskyed 'tshang rgyar gsungs/ /de ni bskal bzang 'di yi gdul bya'i ngor/ /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul de ltar bstan pa ste/ /dgos ched dman rnams 'jug dang bu stong po/ /lung bstan pas ni lha mi khrag khrig phrag /grangs med bzod thob byang chub nges phyir yin/ /des na tshul 'di don gyi dgongs par bzung*/ /sangs rgyas thugs rjes srid gsum rnam grol phyir/ /sna tshogs thabs chen mang pos phan bde mdzad/ /zhing dang ston par sprul pas 'gro kun gyi/ /mtha' yas re skong byang chub sa mthor 'dren/ /rgyal ba'i byin brlabs rnam 'phrul de 'dra'o/ /tshul 'di thos nas mi dngangs dad gyur pa/ /de dag myur du 'jig rten mgon por 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ 'gro ba'i don du zhing khams rnam par bkod pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// // de ltar rgyal ba'i zhing khams snang ba las/ khyad par mi mjed 'jig rten bstan pa ni/ /chags gnas 'jig stongs bskal pa rnam bzhi las/

/dang po la yang bcud rnams yas chags shing*/ /nam mkha' la brten snod kyang de bzhin no/ /sa gzhi la brten snod rnams mas chags te/ /'di dag mdor bsdus rim pas dbye ba ni/ /rten gzhi rten dang brten pa gsum dag las/ /dang po 'byung ba rim brtsegs rang bzhin tshul/ /stongs pa'i bar bskal rdzogs pa'i rjes nyid du/ /yid mkha' rnam dag nam mkha' dkar gsal rgya/ /stong gsum dang mnyam steng du rlung chags te/ /srub byed kun khyab rtsub 'gyur sdud byed dang*/ / smin byed 'byed byed rnam drug rim pa bzhin/ /bsrubs brdal gtor dang sdud chags so sor 'byed/ /mdog ljang rgya gram dbyibs 'dra mu khyud bcas/ /rngams su dpag tshad sa ya drug 'bum la/ /rgyar ni grangs med sra mkhregs rdo rje 'dra/ / gser gyi snying po can sprin 'dus pa las/ /de steng char babs chu yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /zhi ba gsal dag ces bya kun nas zlum/ /rngams su dpag tshad 'bum phrag bcu gcig dang*/ /nyi khri rten byed rlung gis mtha' nas bskor/ / srub byed rlung gis chu de rnams bsrubs pas/ /de steng sa yi dkyil 'khor gru bzhir chags/ /rngams su dpag tshad sum 'bum nyi khri la/ /rgya khyon 'bum phrag bcu gnyis stong phrag gsum/ /brgya phrag phyed dang lnga dang bcas pa'o/ /de steng rten ni ri mtsho gling rnams las/ /chu dang sa bsrubs sprin las char babs pas/ /lhun po gser ri mu khyud gling rnams ni/ /'byed sdud rab 'bring tha ma'i rlung gis grub/ /ri rab rin chen phyogs bzhi rim pa bzhin/ /dngul dang baiḍūr padma rā ga gser/ /de yis phyogs bzhi'i nam mkha' 'ang de bzhin no/ /ri rab bang rim bzhi las 'og ma ni/ /rdo rje can te nang gi ri rab nas/ /zheng du dpag tshad stong phrag bcu drug 'phags/ /chur ni sum 'gyur kun la shes par bya/ /gnyis pa rnam spungs stong phrag brgyad zheng 'phags/ /gsum pa shel 'od 'bar ba bzhi stong 'phags/

/bzhi pa 'khor lo rnam brtsegs nyis stong 'phags/ /chu mtshams nas bzung ri rab phyed du'o/ /lhun po chu las brgyad khri 'phags pa ste/ /chu yi nang du ri gling kun mtshungs par/ /brgyad khri nub cing gser gyi sa gzhir gnas/ / gser gyi ri bdun gru bzhir bskor ba ni/ /gnya' shing 'dzin dang de bzhin gshol mda' 'dzin/ /seng ldeng can dang blta na sdug pa dang*/ /rta rna rnam 'dud mu khyud 'dzin ri rnams/ /nang ma'i phyed phyed phyi ma'i gnam 'phang slebs/ /zheng du chu las 'phags pa de tsam mo/ khor yug ri ni lcags las grub pa ste/ /mu khyud 'dzin ri'i phyed du sleb ces grags/ /de dag nang gi mtsho yi bye brag kyang*/ /shing rta'i srog shing tsam gyi char babs pas/ /ri gling kun gyi bar rnams gang bas mtsho/ /rol mtsho yan lag brgyad ldan chus gang ba'i/ / zheng rnams ri bdun so so dang mnyam zhing*/ /chur yang sum 'gyur kun la mtshungs pa yin/ /mu khyud 'dzin nas khor yug ba tshwa can/ /phyi yi rgya mtsho'i zheng du sum 'bum dang*/ /stong phrag nyi shu rtsa gnyis dpag tshad ldan/ /gling rnams sa gzhi chu dang khad mnyam mtho/ /lus 'phags zla gam ngos gsum nyis stong re/ /'bur ngos dpag tshad sum brgya lnga bcu'o/ /'dzam gling sog kha ngos gsum de dang 'dra/ /ngos gcig dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi pa'o/ /ba glang spyod zlum khor yug bdun stong dang*/ /lnga brgya zheng du stong phrag phyed dang gsum/ /sgra mi snyan gling gru bzhi ngos re'i cha/ /dpag tshad nyis stong mtha' skor brgyad stong ngo*/ /lus dang lus 'phags rnga yab rnga yab gzhan/ /g.yo ldan dang ni de bzhin lam mchog 'gro/ /sgra mi snyan zla rnams ni gtso bo'i phyed/ /bye brag sems can gnas gzhan rnam gnyis las/ /ngan song dag gi dmyal ba'i rang bzhin gnas/ /ti se'i 'og nas dpag tshad nyi khri na/ /mnar med de'i steng gzhan bdun brtsegs mar gnas/ /de dang 'dabs 'byor grang dmyal brgyad po

yang*/ /tsha dmyal rnams la 'gran pa bzhin du gnas/ /nyi tshe'i gnas la nges pa ma mchis shing*/ /nye 'khor ba ni tsha dmyal 'khor du gnas/ / yi dwags rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer 'og /dpag tshad lnga brgya 'das pa rtsa ba'i gnas/ /yan lag lha mi'i 'jig rten dag na'ang yod/ /dud 'gro byings gnas rgya mtsho chen po ste/ kha 'thor lha mi'i yul na gnas pa yin/ /mtho ris mi rnams gling bzhi gling phran te/ /rnga yab srin po gnas phyir gzhan yin no/ /lha gnas gnyis las 'dod lha'i gnas drug ste/ /rgyal chen ris bzhi ri rab bang rim dang*/ /nyi zla skar ma'i gzhal med khang na gnas/ /lhun po'i phyed na nyi zla gza' skar te/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dpag tshad lnga bcu gcig /'og gzhi me shel mtha' chags gser las grub/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dpag tshad lnga bcu pa/ /'og gzhi chu shel mtha' chags dngul las grub/ /gnyis ka'i nang na lha yi grong khyer te/ /skyed tshal rdzing dang lam srang rin chen gzhi/ /me tog char pa pus nub ngang gis 'bab/ /rnying pa 'dor zhing gsar pa gsal bar 'grems/ /skar ma'i tshogs kyang chu shel snying po ste/ /gser gyi ra bas legs bskor lha yi grong*/ /rgyang grags gcig nas drug gi bar yin no/ kha cig gser zangs chu shel 'khar ba la/ /rgyang grags gcig nas bco brgyad bar yin no (1) / ri rab steng na sum cu rtsa gsum gnas/ /ma 'dres 'phreng 'bar gzi brjid mchog la sogs/ /nye dbang gnas ris sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ /gtso bo'i gnas te rtsa gsum mtho ris yul/ /ri rab rtse mo'i ngos bzhi'i rgya khyon la/ / ngos rer dpag tshad brgyad khrir gnas pa'i steng*/ /grong tshal sa gzhi shing dang 'dun sa las/ /dbus na rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzangs mchog /ngos rer dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu pa/ /mtha' skor stong yod lha yi grong khyer las/ / gyen du dpag tshad phyed dang lnga 'phags shing*/ /ba gam brgyad la khang brtsegs bdun bdun gnas/

/de dag re rer gnas khang bdun bdun no/ /phyi rol skyed tshal rin chen rdzing bur bcas/ /de yi phyi rol grong khyer blta na sdug /ngos re dpag tshad nyis stong lnga brgya pa/ /'phangs su phyed dang gsum ste gser las byas/ /gser gyi ra bas bskor zhing mdzes pa ste/ /dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i sgo chen rnams/ /'phangs su dpag tshad phyed dang gsum pa ste/ /zheng du phyed dang gnyis bcas sgo srung ldan/ /lam srang dpag tshad nyis stong lnga brgya pa/ /zheng du bcu gnyis 'jam zhing bde ba ste/ /rdzing dang rin chen ljon shing padmas brgyan/ /grong khyer phyi rol rin chen ra ba bdun/ /bar bar 'obs bdun chu mtsho ngang pas brgyan/ /rin chen gru na lha rnams rtsed 'jo 'phel/ /ri rab rtse mo'i mtshams bzhir khang brtsegs bzhi/ /dpangs su dpag tshad phyed dang lnga pa la/ /ngos rer brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ /gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje'i lha rigs gnas/ /lha yi skyed tshal ra ba rnam bzhi yang*/ /blta na sdug nas dpag tshad nyi shu nyid/ /phyogs bzhir 'das pa'i mtshams na gnas pa las/ /shar na shing rta sna tshogs skyed mos tshal/ /rin chen rdzing dang ljon shing gos dang rgyan/ /lha yi bu mos dga' bar byas pa'o/ /lho na rtsub 'gyur zhes bya'i skyed mos tshal/ /g.yul 'gyed tshe na zhe sdang 'phel ba ste/ /rin chen mtshon dang go cha sra ba 'byung*/ /nub na 'dres tshal rdzing bu bzang po nas/ /sna tshogs longs spyod 'dres mar 'byung ba'o/ /byang na dga' tshal lha yi bu mos gang*/ /bskal bzang 'dren pa stong gi shing dang bcas/ /longs spyod dga' ba lhag par 'phel ba yin/ /de dag chu zheng nyis brgya lnga bcu ste/ /dbyibs legs gser gyi ra ba dpag tshad gcig

/ rin chen lcog gis kun nas mdzes par brgyan/ /nang gi gzhi rnams gser gyi bye mar brdal/ /rin chen skyed tshal rdzing bu chu byas gang*/ /me tog phang phung bung ba gar byed mdzes/ /tshal rnams phyi rol dpag tshad nyi shu na/ /sa gzhi bzang po rnam bzhi rim pa bzhin/ /sna tshogs rtsub 'gyur 'dres pa dga' ba ste/ /rin chen sa gzhir ljon shing chu mtshos brgyan/ /tshad dang bkod pa tshal dang 'dra ba'o/ /shing ni grong khyer mchog de'i byang shar na/ /yongs 'du sa brtol 'phangs su dpag tshad brgya/ /rtsa bar lnga zug phyogs bzhi'i yal ga la/ /dpag tshad lnga phrag bcu bcu rab tu rgyas/ /snying po'i rtse mo gdugs ltar lnga bcus brgyan/ /de nyid 'od kyis phyogs rnams gsal bar byas/ /dri bsung zhim pos rdzi phyogs dpag tshad brgya/ /rdzi phyogs ma yin lnga bcur khyab pa'i grong*/ /ar mo nig 'dra'i rdo leb mdzes pa ste/ /chu zheng dpag tshad lnga bcu'i rang bzhin la/ /dbang po'i khrir bcas me tog char 'bab pas/ /lha rnams dbyar dus zla ba bzhir gnas so/ /blta na sdug nas dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi'i/ /lho nub chos bzangs lha yi 'dun sa ste/ /chu zheng sum brgya mtha' skor dgu brgya zlum/ / dbus na rin chen khang brtsegs 'od 'bar ba/ /cung zad tsam gyis sa la ma reg drung*/ /lha rnams rang gi srid dang bya ba las/ /nyams pa bsrung phyir bgro ba'i gnas yod do/ /nam mkha' la brten 'dod lha'i gnas bzhi ni/ /gza' skar bzhin du mkha' la snang ba ste/ /rgya tshad sum cu rtsa gsum nas bzung ste/ /gong nas gong du nyis 'gyur 'phags pa yin/ / lha min ri rab chu mtshams man chad kyi/ khong gseng nang nas rim pas sgra gcan dang*/ /dkar phreng 'gul phreng thags bzangs ris rnams te/ /rgyu ni yi dwags las kyis 'phangs pa la/ /rdzogs byed lha yi las kyis rdzogs byas pas/ /lha dang 'gran pa'i dpal dang 'byor pas mdzes/ khong gseng gser gyi sa gzhi bzang po'i dbus/

/dbang po'i khang bzangs mchog ni gdams pa can/ /grong khyer gser ldan 'dun sa nor bzangs dang*/ /skyed tshal kun dga' ra dang rab dga' dang*/ /dga' ba dga' ba'i kun dga' ra ba'o/ /sa gzhi'i ming yang de dang 'dra ba ste/ /shing gi mchog ni tsi tra pa tri'o/ /rdo leb bzang po glang chen gangs brtsegs dang*/ bzod par dka' dang rta mchog rab myur ro/ /gzugs khams gnas ris rnam pa bcu bdun ni/ /bsam gtan bzhi'i bar chung 'bring che thob pas/ /tshangs ris nas bzung 'bras bu che'i bar ro/ /bsam gtan bzhi po spel mar rab bsgoms pas/ /chung 'bring chen po ches che mchog che bas/ /mi che ba nas 'og min bar dag tu/ /'phags pa'i gnas gzhan gtsang ris rnam lnga'o/ /de dag gong na srid pa tha ma'i gnas/ / 'og min rnam mdzes sa bcu thob pa'i gnas/ /dwangs shing gsal la yongs su rdzogs pa yin/ /gzugs med pa la dngos snang gnas med do/ /rgya khyon tshad ni bsam gtan bzhi rim bzhin/ /gling bzhi pa dang stong gcig stong gnyis gsum/ /'bras bu che ba'i bar du bstan pa ste/ /gnas gtsang ris lnga rgya khyon tshad med do/ /mtho khyad bar thangs 'dzam bu'i gling nyid nas/ /rgyal chen bzhi dang sum cu rtsa gsum bar/ /dpag tshad bzhi khri bzhi khri yod pa ste/ /de nas mtshe mar brgyad khri dga' ldan du/ /chig 'bum drug khri yod pa'i chas gzhal te/ /gong nas gong mar bgrod pa'i bar snang la/ /'dzam bu'i gling nas gnas der ji tsam zhig /yod pa'i bar thag gong mar brtsis pa yis/ /'og min bar du mtho khyad shes par bya/ /gling bzhi ri rab 'dod lha drug po dang*/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gcig dang bcas pa la/ /gling bzhi pa yi 'jig rten khams zhes bya/ /mu khyud nyi zla'i 'char tshad mnyam pas bskor/ /de nyid stong mthar sum cu rtsa gsum dang*/ /mtho khyad mnyam pa'i lcags ris bskor ba ni/ /spyi phud stong gi 'jig rten khams zhes bya/ /de stong bar ma'i 'jig rten khams yin te/

/ gzhan 'phrul dang mnyam lcags ris kun nas bskor/ /de stong stong gsum 'jig rten chen po'i mthar/ /tshangs ris dang mnyam lcags ris bskor ba na/ /gling bzhi ri rab tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bar/ /ther 'bum gcig ste bye ba phrag brgya re/ /'di dag 'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor yang*/ gcig la brten pas mnyam du chags 'jig gnas/ /theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ snod chags tshul bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// // de nas bcud kyi sems can chags tshul la/ /gzugs med gzugs dang 'dod pa'i khams gsum las/ /thog mar gzugs med rang bzhin bstan pa ni/ /sngar bzh-in thog ma'i 'od gsal las 'khrul te/ /ma rig sas bsdus bsam gtan bzhir gol bas/ /gzugs med bzhi po gong nas 'og mar mched/ /nam mkhar brten nas rim par gnas tshul ni/ /padma rnam par brtsegs pa'i nam mkha' la/ /yod min med min skye mched nye bar brten/ / ting 'dzin gcig gis bskal chen brgyad khri 'da'/ /de 'og dpag tshad stong phrag sum cu na/ /rnam rol 'khor lo can gyi nam mkha' la/ /ci yang med pa'i skye mched brten pa ni/ /bskal chen drug khri'i bar du gnas pa'o/ /de nas dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu'i 'og /rnam rol 'khor lo 'phro ba'i nam mkha' la/ /rnam shes mtha' yas bskal chen bzhi khrir gnas/ de 'og dpag tshad stong phrag gcig nyid na/ /sprin chen rnam par rol pa'i nam mkha' la/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas bskal chen nyi khrir gnas/ /de ltar gzugs med rnam pa bzhi po yang*/ /'dod gzugs ji bzhin gdos bcas 'od min pas/ /rnam shes mi g.yo ting 'dzin rtse gcig nyid/ /yi dwags dag dang bar do'i sems can bzhin/ /'gyu byed yid kyi lus su med pas na/ /rnam shes nang gsal ting 'dzin zhi bder gnas/ /dmyal ltar myong rig sdug bsngal lus med pas/ /rtse gcig zhi bde'i bsam gtan chu bos brlan/

/de phyir stong rig ting 'dzin lus zhes bya/ /de ltar rten dang brten pa'i tshul bstan pas/ /gzugs med pa la gnas gzugs 'dod pa min/ /gnas ni khang khyim yul la sogs pa ste/ / gzugs ni rang mtshan phan tshun snang nus pa/ /de med phyir na gzugs gnas dngos snang med/ /brten par bstan pas yod na ming bzhi yi/ /phung po nyid kyang de ltar 'gyur ba nyid/ /nam mkha'i go rim bstan pas der 'gyur na/ /gang du shi sa'ang de dang cis mi mtshungs/ /des na tshul 'di rgyud sder rab tu bshad/ / legs bshad dam pa'i phul du 'di zungs shig / de nas gzugs khams dag gi rang bzhin ni/ /bsam gtan bzhi dang dge ba bcu 'bras kyis/ /'od kyi lus la sems kyi rgyud brten nas/ /ting 'dzin dga' bas yun ring gnas pa yin/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched 'og dag nas/ /dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu gzhal ba na/ /rin chen mching bu rnam bkod nam mkha' la/ /gong ma las mched 'od gsal dwangs pa'i gzugs/ /ting 'dzin skyon med 'phags pa'i gnas thob ste/ /gnas gzhan snang ba kun gyi rtser gyur pas/ /'og min zhes bya der gnas lha rnams kyang*/ / lus bongs dpag tshad khri dang drug stong la/ /tshe yi tshad kyang bar bskal de snyed thub/ rin chen mthon mthing spras pa'i nam mkha' la/ /shin tu mthong ste lus bongs dpag tshad ni/ /brgyad stong tshe yang bar bskal de snyed do/ /rin chen rnam mdzes zhes bya'i nam mkha' la/ /gong ma las mched gya nom snang ba'i lha/ / lus bongs dpag tshad bzhi stong gsal ba las/ /tshe yang bar bskal de snyed thub pa yin/ /rin chen ze ba smug gu'i nam mkha' la/ /mi gdung ba ste dpag tshad nyis stong lus/ /tshe yang bar gyi bskal pa de snyed do/ /rin chen shel khang brtsegs pa'i nam mkha' la/ /mi che ba ste lus bongs dpag tshad stong*/ /tshe yang bar bskal stong phrag gcig yin no/ /rin chen rab mdzes rnam brdal nam mkha' la/

/'bras bu che'i lha dpag tshad lnga brgya'i lus/ /tshe yang bar gyi bskal pa de snyed do/ /rin chen ka lis spras pa'i nam mkha' la/ /bsod nams skyes lha lus bongs dpag tshad ni/ /nyis brgya lnga bcu bar bskal de snyed tshe/ / rin chen sprin tshogs stug po'i nam mkha' la/ /sprin med lha de lus bongs dpag tshad ni/ /brgya dang nyer lnga bar bskal de snyed tshe/ /rin chen 'od 'byin zhes bya'i nam mkha' la/ /dge rgyas dpag tshad drug cu rtsa bzhi'i lus/ /tshe yi tshad kyang bar bskal de snyed do/ /rin chen ind+ra nī la'i nam mkha' la/ /tshad med dge'i lha lus bongs dpag tshad ni/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis bar bskal de snyed tshe/ /rin chen pe taṅki ling nam mkha' la/ /dge chung dpag tshad bcu drug bar bskal tshe/ /rin chen shrī ku tra'i nam mkha' la/ /'od gsal dpag tshad brgyad lus tshe mtshungs ldan/ /rin chen ke ke rus spras nam mkha' la/ /tshad med 'od lha dpag tshad bzhi pa'i lus/ /tshe yang bar gyi bskal pa de snyed do/ /rin chen dpa' ba'i 'od kyi nam mkha' la/ /'od chung dpag tshad gnyis lus tshe mtshungs so/ /rin chen ke ru dza yi nam mkha' la/ /tshangs chen lus bongs dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis/ /tshe yang bar gyi bskal pa de snyed do/ /rin chen sa mi ka yi nam mkha' la/ /tshangs pa kun 'khor dpag tshad gcig lus tshe/ /rin chen pi tang ka yi nam mkha' la/ /tshangs ris dpag tshad phyed lus bar bskal phyed/ /de dag gzhal med khang bcas rdzus skyes pas/ /pha dang ma med kun rdzogs gos dang bcas/ /ting 'dzin zas spyod kham gyis mi 'tsho ste/ /rnam bzhi'i yon tan rang bzhin nyid phyir ro/ /'dod pa'i khams la lha rigs drug bshad pa/ /dpag bsam rin chen brgyan pa'i nam mkha' la/ /gzhan 'phrul rgyang grags phyed dang gnyis pa'i lus/ /gzhu 'dom phyed dang brgyad brgya'i rang bzhin te/ /lo stong drug brgya nyin zhag gcig brtsis pa'i/ /rang lo khri dang drug stong thub pa yin/

/dpag bsam mthong mdzes zhes bya'i nam mkha' la/ / 'phrul dga' rgyang grags gcig dang bzhi cha'i lus/ /gzhu 'dom lnga brgya brgya dang nyi shu lnga/ /mi lo brgyad brgya nyin zhag gcig brtsis pa'i/ /rang lo brgyad stong bar du gnas pa yin/ /dpag bsam mig mdzes brgyan pa'i nam mkha' la/ /dga' ldan chos mchog longs spyod dga' ba can/ /rgyang grags gcig lus gzhu 'dom lnga brgya ste/ /mi lo bzhi brgya nyin zhag gcig brtsis pa'i/ / rang lo bzhi stong bar snyed thub pa'o/ /dpag bsam yid 'gyur brgyan pa'i nam mkha' la/ /'thab bral lus bongs rgyang grags bzhi gsum ste/ /gzhu 'dom sum brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga'o/ /mi lo nyis brgya zhag gcig brtsis pa yi/ /rang lo nyis stong bar snyed gnas pa'o/ /de ltar 'dod lha'i longs spyod phun tshogs te/ /bdud rtsi'i zas sogs shin tu rgya che'o/ /'dod pa spyod pa'ang gzhan 'phrul nas rim bzhin/ /bltas dgod lag bcangs gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa ste/ /rim bzhin gcig gnyis gsum bzhir ldan pa nyid/ /btsa' ba'ang pang nas gos med gcer bu ste/ /lo bcu nas bzung lo lnga'i bar rim bzhin/ /'dzam gling byis pa rnams kyi na tshod nyid/ /dpag bsam yongs 'dus brgyan pa'i sa gzhi la/ /sum cu rtsa gsum rgyang grags bzhi cha gnyis/ /gzhu 'dom nyis brgya lnga bcu'i rang bzhin lus/ /mi yi lo brgya rang lo stong phrag gcig /ri rab rin chen sna bzhi'i bang rim la/ /rgyal chen ris bzhi rgyang grags bzhi cha'i lus/ / gzhu 'dom brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /mi lo lnga bcu nyin zhag gcig brtsis pa'i/ /rang lo lnga brgya'i bar du gnas pa'o/ /lha min rnams la rigs ni rnam pa lnga/ /tshe dpal lha dang stobs chen gnod sbyin dang*/ /rtsub 'gyur bdud dang gsod byed srin po dang*/ /gdug pa klu yi rigs te 'gro ba'ang de/ /lus dang tshe yang ma nges sna tshogs pa'o/ /mi rnams 'od gsal las mched 'dzam gling du/

/ ring zhig gnas las gnyis mched lus 'phags su/ /rdzus skyes de nas sgra mi snyan mched cing*/ /de las ba lang spyod pa nye bar mched/ /'dzam gling lus tshad tshe lo dpag med nas/ /brgyad khri yan chad rang khru sum cu gnyis/ /phyis ni khru bzhi phyed dang bzhi pa nyid/ /lus 'phags mi rnams rang khru brgyad pa ste/ /tshe lo nyis brgya lnga bcu thub pa'o/ /ba lang spyod mi lus khru bcu drug pa/ /tshe lo lnga brgya sgra mi snyan stong ste/ /lus khru sum cu rtsa gnyis nges pa yin/ /khyad par 'dzam gling sems can chags tshul ni/ /'od gsal lha las bsod nams chung ngu zhig /gling 'dir 'ongs rjes yang gcig de bzhin byung*/ /zla zhes mngon brjod de nas mang zhig mched/ /mkha' la 'gro zhing 'od bcas dga' bde'i zas/ / tshe lo dpag med nyon mongs mngon gyur med/ /de tshe bskal pa dang po zhes bya'o/ /grong med sa gzhi khad mnyam mdzes pa ste/ /nyi zla med cing skyes pa bud med med/ /kun kyang rdzus skyes sems can zhes byar grags/ /de nas ring mo zhig na mkha' dbyings las/ /mi snang zhes grags tshun chad mi zhes grags/ /de nas tshe dang 'od bri bsod nams chung*/ nyon mongs mngon gyur med kyang langs su nye/ /'di dus gling gzhan mi rnams mched pa yin/ /'dzam bu gling zhes rab tu grags pa yang*/ rdo rje gdan nas byang du ri nag po/ /dgu 'das gangs ri'i byang na spos ngad ldan/ /de gnyis bar na ma dros mtsho chen ni/ /gru bzhi chu zheng dpag tshad lnga bcu pa/ /yan lag brgyad ldan chu yis gang ba'o/ /phyogs bzhi kha 'bab bzhi las 'bab pa'i chu/ /gaṅgā sindhu pakṣu si ta rnams/ /ma dros mtsho la lan bdun g.yas bskor nas/ /chu bran lnga brgya'i 'khor dang lhan cig tu/ / phyogs bzhi'i rgya mtshor ngang gis 'bab pa yin/ /mtsho 'gram dzambū bṛkṣa'i sdong po las/ /shing tog mtshor lhung gser du gyur pa ni/ /lan grangs bcu drug bzhus pa'i gser dang mtshungs/

/dzam bu'i shing gis brgyan phyir de skad grags/ de nas mi rnams dga' bdes g.yengs gyur pas/ /tshe lo bye ba dag na sgong skyes te/ /kun kyang 'od lnga'i sgo nga las skyes shing*/ /'od ni 'dom bdun rlung gis mkha' la 'gro/ /de nas tshe lo sa ya drug 'bum na/ /'od bri 'dom gang drod gsher skye ba ste/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang cang shes rta mchog byung*/ /de nas mi rnams 'dod pas g.yengs gyur nas/ /tshe dpal 'byor pa'ang rim gyis bri bar gyur/ /slar yang dpag bsam shing las 'dod byung ste/ /'bras bu za zhing lo ma gos su gyon/ /phan tshun mthong dang reg na bde ba 'byung*/ de nas pho mo'i dbang po srol dod cing*/ /phan tshun bltas pas reg pa'i 'dod chags byung*/ /shing bcad pa las 'dod 'byung ljon shing nub/ /de nas tshe dang bsod nams bri ba yis/ /sbrang rtsi'i ro 'dra sa yi bcud za zhing*/ /phan tshun dgod pas tshim pa'i 'dod chags byung*/ /'od nyams gti mug dbang gis mun pa byung*/ spyi mthun las kyis nyi zla gza' skar byung*/ /nyin mtshan la sogs dus tshigs yod par gyur/ /de nas rim bzhin sa yi zhag dang ni/ /myu gu'i tshal dang phub ma med 'bras byung*/ /rags pa'i zas des bshang gci'i lam dang ni/ /pho mo'i dbang po'ang legs par dod gyur pas/ /'khyud cing dbang po sbyor ba'i 'dod chags byung*/ /ngo tsha'i dbang gis 'jag khyim byung ba ste/ /de dag yan chad bskal pa rdzogs ldan no/ /de nas le los gsog 'jog byas pa yis/ /'bras la phub shun brngas pa'ang mngon par gyur/ /so sor bgos pas phan tshun brku ba

'byung*/ /de tshe rang bzhin bzang ba'i skyes bu zhig /kun gyis bkur bas rgyal po zhes bya ste/ /mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal po thog mar byung*/ /'ga' zhig khyim nas phyi rol phyogs pa la/ /bram ze zhes grags gtsang sbra spyod pa byung*/ /'ga' zhig khyim gnas 'byor ldan pha ma bkur/ /de dag ming yang rje'u rigs zhes su grags/ /'ga' zhig chos min spyod pas dmangs rigs zhes/ /mi rigs rnam bzhir grags pa de nas byung*/ /ngan song dag las dmyal ba'i sems can ni/ / gang zhig bdag por 'gyur ba'i las bsags pas/ /gshin rje'i rgyal por gyur rjes de yi 'khor/ /dmyal ba'i srung ma rnams dang khyi dang bya/ /me dang mtshon rnams las kyi dbang gis byung*/ /de bzhin yi dwags dud 'gro'i chags tshul yang*/ /rang rang las kyis gnas rigs der snang ste/ /yul don lus kyi snang ba sdug bsngal snang*/ /de ltar dmyal gnas sems can gcig skyes pa/ /de srid bar snyed chags pa'i bskal pa ste/ /snod chags pa la bar bskal gcig dang ni/ /bcud la bcu dgu bsdoms pas nyi shu nyid/ /'jig rten chags pa'i bskal pa lags par gsungs/ /theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ bcud kyi sems can chags pa'i rang bzhin bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// // de nas gnas pa'i bar bskal nyi shu ni/ /thog ma bar dang tha ma gsum nyid de/ /dang po tshe lo dpag med nas bzung nas/ /bcu pa'i bar du nyis brgya (1) brgya brgyas 'bri/ /ya thog ring mo 'grib pa'i bskal pa'o/ /de nas 'phel dang 'grib gnyis zung gcig gis/ /tshan pa bco brgyad 'phel 'grib bar khug ste/ /brgya brgya dag na sde tshan 'phel 'grib byed/ /de nas sngar bzhin yar skye mar 'grib ni/ /ma thog ring mo zhes su grags pa yin/ /ya thog ma thog bar khug bcas pa la/ /bar bskal nyi shu rang bzhin gnas par 'dod/ /'di dag 'phel 'grib cung zad bshad pa ni/

/brgyad khri'i dus na grong khyer 'byor pa yis/ /sa gzhi bya gag 'phur bas sleb tsam gang*/ /'khor los sgyur ba dag kyang mang byung zhing*/ /'byor ba rgya che 'dod lha'i yul dang 'gran/ /de nas mi dge'i dbang gis mar 'grib ste/ /drug khri pa dang nyi khri bcu pa'i bar/ /tshe dang longs spyod yul gyi yon tan 'grib/ /bcu pa'i tshe na rnam rtog nyon mongs rags/ /mi rnams lus bongs mtho gang chag gang la/ /nyin 'tshig nub 'khyags dbul phongs 'tshe bas gdungs/ /'bru bzang nub ste drug cu'i kha zas dang*/ /lwa ba gyon zhing dar zab la sogs nub/ /lan tshwa gtan med zho las mar mi 'byung*/ /pha ma dge sbyong bram ze la sogs pa/ /mi bkur smod cing ngan pa rnams la bstod/ /de dag zad byed mtshon nad mu ge las/ /dang po mtshon gyi bskal pa 'byung tshul ni/ /mi rnams phan tshun 'khrugs cing sdang ba las/ /sa las ci blangs mtshon cha'i rang bzhin 'gyur/ /gcig gis gcig gsod ngan song gnas su ltung*/ /de nas nad kyis thebs shing 'chi bar 'gyur/ /mi rnams lhag ma mu ges tshar 'byin te/ /gab tshe ba dang rus gong dkar po dang*/ /thur ma ba ste bkres skom 'bar bas gdungs/ /de nas 'phel ba'i rim pa bstan pa ni/ /'ga' zhig lus pa grong khyer 'ongs pa na/ /gcig gis gcig mthong dga' ba'i sems skyes te/ /srog gcod spangs pas bu dang bu mo rnams/ /nyi shu par gyur ma byin len spangs pas/ /bzhi bcu pa ste rim bzhin 'dod log dang*/ /phra ma ngag 'khyal rtsub mo brnab sems dang*/ /gnod sems log lta mi rigs 'dod pa dang*/ /chags dang log pa'i chos rnams spangs pa yis/ /brgya dang nyis brgya lnga brgya stong dang ni/ /nyis stong lnga stong khri dang nyi khri dang*/ /bzhi khri brgyad khri'i bar du gong 'phel lo/ /tshe bzhin gzugs dang longs spyod phun tshogs 'phel/ /bar khug rnams la mi rabs bcu gnyis te/ /ya thog ma thog de bas ring ba yin/

/de ltar gnas dus chos kyi bye brag kyang*/ /'gro ba drug dang skye ba rnam pa bzhi/ /gzhi drug dus bcu dngos po bcu bdun dang*/ /yo byad bcu bzhi rjes su spyod pa brgyad/ /'jig rten spyod bcu gtam ni rnam pa gsum/ /nyes rtsom nyer gnyis de bzhin sems can rigs/ /drug cu rtsa gsum dus brgyad 'jug pa bzhi/ /'tsho ba drug dang kun nas bsrung ba drug /nga rgyal bdun dang rgyags pa rnam pa bdun/ /tha snyad bzhi dang tha snyad mang po'i gzhi/ / mkhas pa drug dang bka' yi dngos po dgu /'khor gyi dngos po brgyad la sogs par grags/ /de ltar gnas tshe khyad par gzhan bstan pa/ /bkres skom 'dod yod gzugs dang gzugs med med/ /gling gsum kha zas rnam pa mang ldan zhing*/ /sgra mi snyan na sā li gcig pu nyid/ /'dod lha bdud rtsi yan chad ting 'dzin zas/ /mi la bshang gci lha rnams la yod min/ /gling gsum char 'bab che chung snang ba ste/ /sgra mi snyan lha rnams la de med do/ /de bzhin nor 'bru nyo tshong lo legs nyes/ /ched du byas pa'i gnas kyang mtshungs pa nyid/ /gling gsum 'dod lha'i gnas na kha dog bzhi/ /gzugs dang sgra mi snyan na dkar po nyid/ /gling gsum ras bal dar zab snal ma'i gos/ /sgra mi snyan lha drug na srab 'jam yang*/ /gling gsum tsha grang sgra mi snyan lha med/ /sgra mi snyan rnams ma gtogs 'dod lha mi/ /bag ma gtong len gong ma'i khams na med/ /rje 'bangs bran g.yog pho mo mtshungs par brjod/ /'dod lha drug la nor yod 'bru med cing*/ /sgra mi snyan na 'bru yod nor med la/ /gnyen med gzugs dang 'dra ba nyid yin no/ /gling gsum 'bru nor gnyen dang ldan pa nyid/ /tshangs ris la sogs gong ma'i khams na med/ /rdzus skyes ro med gzhan rnams ro dang bcas/ 'gro ba 'ang rang gi rdzu 'phrul grub pa'am/ /gzhan la brten nas gong mar phyin 'gyur gyi/ /gzhan du 'og mas gong ma mthong ba med/

/tshangs ris la sogs 'dzam gling 'ong ba'i tshe/ /'og ma'i sar brten sprul pas 'ong ba'o/ /gling bzhi'i mi la nyin mtshan snang ba'i cha/ /'dod lhar padmo bye dang zum pas 'byed/ /sgra mi snyan pa shi nas rtsa gsum skye/ /gzhan rnams ma nges las kyis sna tshogs nyid/ / de dag rnams kyang bsdu na gsum nyid de/ /gzugs dang dus dang ming las rab tu dbye/ /gzugs mtha' phra rab rdul te bdun 'gyur gyis/ /phra rab rdul phran lcags chu ri bong lug /glang dang nyi zer sro ma shig nas sor/ /sor mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi khru gang ste/ khru bzhi gzhu gang de nyid lnga brgya la/ /rgyang grags gcig ste dgon pa'i tshad du bstan/ /rgyang grags brgyad la dpag tshad ces bya'o/ /dus mtha'i skad cig ma ste se gol gyi/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi'i cha gcig brgya nyi shu/ /de yi skad cig drug cu thang cig ste/ /sum cu yud tsam sum cu nyin zhag gcig / sum cu zla ba bcu gnyis lo gcig go /ming mtha' yi ge sil bu 'dus pa las/ /ming 'byung brtags na yi ge sil bu nyid/ /spu dang thag pa g.yag rnga ne'u gsing bzhin/ /ming las tshig 'byung bka' dang bstan bcos nyid/ /brtags na yi ge sil bu ma 'byar ba'o/ /theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ gnas pa'i bskal pa bstan pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// // de nas 'jig pa'i bskal pa bstan pa ni/ /gnas pa rdzogs nas dmyal ba'i jig rten du/ /gsar du skye bar mi 'gyur gang yin pa/ /'jig pa'i thog ma dang po de nas 'jog /las zad rnams ni mtho ris skye 'gyur zhing*/ /dmyal myong las ma zad rnams gzhan dag gi /dmyal gnas rnams su 'pho bar 'gyur ba yin/ /de bzhin yi dwags dud 'gro rnams mtshungs te/ /ngan song gsum na sems can med par 'gyur/ /mi yi 'jig rten gling bzhi'i 'jig tshul yang*/ / sgra mi snyan pa rtsa gsum skye 'gyur zhing*/ /gzhan gsum mtshungs par bsam gtan skye ba ni/

/mi zhig slob dpon med par chos nyid kyis/ /bsam gtan gnyis pa thob nas bsgrags pa ni/ /dben las skyes pa'i dga' bde zhi ba'o/ / zhes sgra gling gsum bsgrags tshe mi rnams kun/ /bsam gtan gnyis pa thob nas shi 'phos te/ /'od gsal lhar skyes gling rnams stongs par gyur/ /de bzhin 'dod lhas bsam gtan gnyis pa thob/ /'od gsal skyes tshe 'dod khams stongs zhes bya/ /de nas gzugs khams 'jig pa'ang de bzhin te/ / bsam gtan gnyis pa thob par bsgrags pa'i sgra/ /thos nas bsgrubs pas tshangs pa'i lha rnams kun/ /'od gsal lhar skyes tshangs gnas stongs par gyur/ / de nas snod kyi 'jig rten 'jig pa ni/ /me chu rlung gis bsreg bshal 'thor ba ste/ /nyi ma gcig gis rtswa shing nags tshal sreg /gnyis kyis lteng ka chu klung ma lus skem/ /gsum gyis chu klung chen po thams cad skem/ /bzhi yis ma dros mtsho chen skem pa ste/ /lnga yis rgya mtsho dpag tshad brgyad skem zhing*/ / rim gyis chu thigs gcig kyang med par byed/ /drug gis sa chen gangs ri bcas pa sreg /bdun gyis ri gling gser gyi sa gzhi'i bar/ /thams cad lhag ma med par sreg pa yin/ /me des dmyal ba'i gzhir khyab sreg cing 'bar/ / gyen du rlung gis rab tu bskyod pa yis/ /tshangs pa'i gzhal med khang rnams bsregs pa na/ /'od gsal lha y-i bu rnams dngangs shing skrag /rgan po dag gis sngon yang byung zhes sgrog /de ltar me yis lan bdun bsregs pa'i rjes/ / mkha' las char babs stong gsum khyab pa las/ /bsam gtan gnyis pa man chad zhig par 'gyur/ /bsregs pa'i thal ba chu dang 'dres par gnas/ /de nas rlung gis phyogs bcur gtor ba yis/ /bsam gtan gsum pa man chad zhig par 'gyur/ /rdul phran cha med mkha' dbyings gcig tu 'khyil/ /de yang bsam gtan gsum na rim pa bzhin/ /rtog dpyod me 'dra dga' bde chu dang 'dra/ / dbugs kyi 'byung rngub rlung dang 'dra ba ste/

/skyon gsum mtshungs ldan 'byung ba gsum gyis 'jig /bzhi pa na med gzhan gyis mi 'jig kyang/ /rang gi las kyis de nas 'chi 'phor snang*/ /sa yis mi 'jig snod kyi rang bzhin phyir/ / bsam gtan 'jig pa'i sngon du de yi lha/ /gong mar skye ba chos nyid lags par gsungs/ /de ltar 'jig pa bar bskal nyi shu'o/ /zhig nas stongs te nam mkha' gcig gi ngang*/ /bar bskal nyi shu'i yun dang mnyam pa yin/ /de nas yang gcig chags pa'i mgo rtsom mo/ /de ltar phun tshogs snang ba'i 'jig rten yang*/ /mi brtan med par 'gyur ba'i skabs yod na/ /srid la dga' ba'i rang bzhin de spongs la/ /zhi bde thar pa'i byang chub bsgrub par mdzod/ /theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ 'jig pa dang stongs pa'i bskal pa bstan pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// // de ltar snod bcud rang bzhin bstan pa las/ /de yi bde sdug spel ma'i snang tshul ni/ /'gro drug las kyis so sor myong ba yin/ /dge bas bde 'gro bde ba thams cad dang*/ / mi dges ngan 'gro sdug bsngal thams cad do/ / spel mas bde sdug 'dres mar myong ba ni/ /las tshul sna tshogs dbang gis snang ba yin/ /'di ltar bsam gtan gzugs med khams na yang*/ /dge bas bskyed pa'i bsam gtan zhi bde dang*/ /tshe ring bskal par gnas pa de yod kyang*/ /zag bcas 'khor ba yin phyir rtag pa med/ /mi dge'i dbang gis de nas tshe 'pho'i tshe/ /phyi ma'i gnas la skrag pa'i sdug bsngal ldan/ / 'dod khams na yang bde sdug sna tshogs te/ /sems dmyal yi dwags dud 'gro'i 'jig rten na/ /rang rang mi dges bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal ni/ /tsha grang bkres skom gsod gcod brdeg 'tshog sogs/ /bzod dka' yun ring myong bar 'gyur ba dang*/ / rang rang sngon dges bskyed pa'i bde 'bras ni/ /yi dwags zas sogs rnyed dang cung zad bde/ /nyin mtshan 'gyur te bar 'ga' sdug bsngal chung*/

/rgyal dang de sras rdzu 'phrul 'od bkye bas/ /sdug bsngal zhi 'gyur gang de bde ba'i 'bras/ / spel mar snang ba las las gyur pa yin/ /mi rnams la yang gnas dang longs spyod dang*/ /'khor dang grags 'byor tshe ring nad med sogs/ /bde ba'i char snang rnam pa sna tshogs dang*/ /sdug bsngal yang ni skye rga na 'chi dang*/ /bshes bral dgra dang phrad cing mi 'dod dang*/ /sdug bsngal 'byor pa rgud cing phongs pas nyen/ /mi bsngags tsha grang bkres skom la sogs pa/ /sna tshogs mang ldan bzod dka' rnams dang ldan/ /de kun rang gi 'khrul snang las las gyur/ /lha min rnams la'ang rang bzhin gyis lha yi/ / dpal la sdang phyir 'khrug dang yid mi bde/ /phan tshun 'tshe zhing mi bsrun rtsub pa ste/ /me tog phreng brgyus 'byor pa'i skyed mos tshal/ /bdud rtsi'i zas dang khang brtsegs bzhon pa sogs/ / bde mang yun ring spyad kyang ngoms pa med/ / gzhan 'phrul la sogs 'dod lha drug na yang*/ /bde mang lha yi 'byor pas nyams dga' yang*/ /rmi lam sad bzhin spangs nas 'gro dgos la/ /'chi 'pho ltung ba'i sdug bsngal dpag med ldan/ khyad par ri rab rtser gnas lha rnams kyi/ /dge bas bskyed pa'i 'byor bde rab mang po/ /grong dang skyed tshal rdo leb shing chen dang*/ /dbang po'i btsun mo bu stong dpa' ba ste/ /me tog mgor brgyan lha mo rnams kyis gang*/ /cang shes sprin gyi shugs 'chang rta mchog dang*/ / rab brtan glang po sa srung bu mdzes kyi/ /mgo bo sum cu rtsa gsum steng rol zhing*/ /rtse dga'i dus ston nyin mtshan phyad par spyod/ /sdug bsngal yang ni 'chi 'pho ltung ba dang*/ /lha min rnams dang 'thab rtsod g.yul 'gyed do/ / rgyu ni gsum ste 'dzam gling las dang ni/ /shing dang bu mo lta las gyur pa'o/ /dkar phyogs dag dang de bzhin nag po yi/ /klu dang bar snang lha rnams 'khrug pa ste/ /srid dang sder bcas rtsod cing 'byed par byed/

/dkar phyogs klu mchog brgyad dang nag po yi/ /klu rnams g.yul 'gyed bar snang lhas dpung gnon/ /sgra gcan 'khrugs te rtsod pa pham gyur pa/ /de tshe rgyal chen ris bzhi'i lha mchog lhags/ /dkar 'phreng gnas nas 'gul 'phreng 'khrug pa 'gyed/ / pham gyur thags bzangs ris sbran bskyod pa yis/ /ri rab 'gul tshe dbang po nye dbang bcas/ /rtsub 'gyur tshal song go cha rab bgos te/ /rab brtan bzhon pa lha yi dpung dang bcas/ /ri rab chu mtshams thug par bsu ba las/ / g.yul 'gyed ri rab 'phen zhing nyi zla 'dzin/ /lha rnams gyen du mi 'greng bdun du 'phags/ /rab dkar bsod nams stobs las gyur pa yin/ /lha min dpung rgyal ri rab rtser son zhing*/ /lha rnams grong khyer sgo 'phar zhag bdun gcod/ /lha min pham gyur gser gyi sa gzhi'i grong*/ /zhag bdun sgo 'phar bcad de gnas pa yin/ /de ltar lha dang lha min rtsod pa las/ /sdug bsngal mang ldan sdar ma rnams byer zhing*/ /brgyal 'gyur mya ngan chen po skye ba yin/ /de 'dra'i 'khor ba me yi 'obs 'dra las/ /blo ldan rnams kyis thar pa bsgrub par bya/ /'khor ba'i gnas na yid brtan 'ga' med de/ /bde bar snang yang 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal nyid/ /gtan du 'khor ba zo chun 'khyud mo 'dra/ /

de phyir de las thar phyir brtson 'tshal lo/ /theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ snod bcud kyi bde sdug bstan pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// // de nas 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las/ /brgal phyir ded dpon dpal ldan bla ma bsten/ /de yang thabs mkhas thugs rje dpag med cing*/ / mdo rgyud yid bzhin mdzod mnga' 'gro ba 'dren/ /skyon bral yon tan rdzogs pa'i bla ma ni/ /snyigs ma'i dus su sangs rgyas dngos dang mtshungs/ /rab dang sri zhi gus pas spyi bos bsten/ /rang bzhin yon tan rdzogs pa'i bla ma ni/ / rigs bzang ngo tsha khrel yod dbang po tshang*/ /byams dang snying rje shes rab rgya che zhing*/ /mang thos sgo gsum dul zhing bzod chen ldan/ /gsong zhing des la gya gyu med pa ste/ /yid bzhin rin ched dad brgya'i gtsug gis bsten/ /srid las rnam grol mchog rab bla ma ni/ /yul dang rgyang bsring mi chos rgyab tu bor/ / dgos med rang bzhin nor rdzas zhen pa chung*/ /rgyu 'bras yid ches dge sdig blang dor byed/ /tshe 'di blos thongs (1) yun gyi don chen sgrub/ /theg chen don ldan 'gro don thabs mkhas spyod/ /brtags shing ngo mtshar dpal ldan chos kyi rje/ /rtag tu 'bral med skyo ngal med par bsten/ /shes rab rgya che skal bzang bla ma ni/ /rig gnas kun mkhyen shes bya'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /thos bsam rgya che grub mtha'i tshig don mkhas/ /lta spyod phul byung gang gis smad du med/ /lung rigs dang ldan rang bzo gzu lum med/ /gdul bya'i blo rigs brtags nas chos ston cing*/ /byang chub lam 'dren ded dpon blo mig can/ /rin chen thar gling bgrod de gus pas bsten/ /rim brgyud byin rlabs ldan pa'i bla ma ni/ / gong ma mnyes byas grub thob brgyud pa 'dzin/ /thugs mdzod lon pas snyan brgyud gdams pa ldan/ /phyag bzhes mthong bas don gnyis sgrub la mkhas/

/ sgrub la brtson pas dngos grub sprin tshogs brnyes/ /gzhan snang bsgyur nus thar pa'i lam sna 'dren/ /mdo rgyud bka' babs dam tshig gtsang gyur pa/ /de 'dra'i mkhas grub dpal mgon spyi bos bsten/ /thugs rjes lam sna 'dren pa'i bla ma ni/ /byang chub sems 'byongs rtag tu gzhan don spyod/ /byin rlabs zhugs pas gzhan snang byin gyis rlobs/ /lta sgom spyod 'bras nyams myong drod rtags ldan/ /nus mthu rab ldan gdon bgegs bar chad sel/ /thabs mkhas thar lam 'gro ba 'dren pa'i mchog /mtshungs med 'jig rten rgyan gyur gus pas bsten/ /mthar thug snying po'i don ston bla ma ni/ /'brel tshad rnam grol zab mo'i don la sbyor/ /lam zab snying pos rang gnas chos sku sprod/ /bogs 'don zab mos nyams rtogs gong 'phel byed/ /mthar phyin rtogs pas gnas lugs gzhi la skyel/ /thabs lam zab mos gang yang lam du sgyur/ /gdams pa mang ldan shes rgyud 'grol la mkhas/ /tshe 'dir 'khor ba'i chu bo sgrol nus pa/ /ded dpon yid bzhin sman pa'i rgyal po ni/ /kun las 'phags phyir mtshungs med gus pas bsten/ /ji skad bshad pa'i yon tan mchog dag las/ /kun ldan bla ma u dumbā ra tsam/ /phal cher ldan pa'ang sangs rgyas dang 'dra zhing*/ /drug tshan tsam ldan de yang bsten rung ste/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir rab tu rnyed dka'i phyir/ /rab tu gus pa chen pos bsten par bya/ /'bral med rgyun du bsten par gdams pa yang*/ /gtan gyi 'dun gros thar lam zab mo nyid/ /bla ma las gzhan gang gis ston mi 'gyur/ /de phyir rtag tu bla ma bsten par bya/ /dge sdig spang blang zab mo'i gnad ston cing*/ /sdug bsngal nad sel ma rig 'thibs po sel/ /shes rab mig 'byed thar lam snang byed pa/ /bla ma las gzhan med phyir rtag tu bsten/ /thar lam bsgrub pa'ang tshogs gnyis rdzogs la rag /de yi rten yang bla ma las lhag pa/

/lha bcas 'jig rten kun na med pa'i phyir/ / zhing gi mchog gyur gus pas rtag tu bsten/ /ngan 'gro'i srid dang bar chad 'jigs rnams las/ /skyob phyir skyabs kyi dam pa'ang gzhan med de/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang bla ma la bsten phyir/ /log 'gro'i 'jigs bral phyir yang rtag tu bsten/ /yon tan rdzogs byed pa yang gzhan med de/ /bla ma la brten de las phun tshogs phyir/ /thog ma bar dang mthar yang rnam grol gyi/ /yon tan 'byor slad rab dang gus pas bsten/ khyad par snyigs dus brtse ldan bla ma las/ / gzhan zhig bdag gi ston par mi 'gyur bas/ /rgyal las lhag pa'i gus pa chen pos bsten/ /de yang dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dag /gang na bzhugs pa'i yul phyogs der bgrod de/ /dad gus sri zhu chen po dang ldan pas/ /thog ma nyid nas mnyes byas yang dag btsal/ /rnyed nas skyo ngal med par bsten bya ste/ /don chen bsgrub la ngang chen gus pas bsring*/ /de tshe mi mthun rkyen rnams grangs mang bas/ /yid 'byung phyir phyogs blo mang skye ba la/ /bdud du shes nas slar yang gus mchog gis/ /nor bu rnyed pa mi 'dor spyi bos bsten/ /ji ltar chu rnyog pa las dwangs pa yi/ /gzugs brnyan 'char nub rnyog bral nor bu ltar/ / sgrib pa'i chu dwangs yon tan gzugs brnyan ston/ /rdo khams gser dang sa 'og rin chen gter/ /padma'i nang gnas bder gshegs ji lta bar/ /khyab bdag khams gtsang byang chub snying po ston/ /mtshan mo'i mun nag snang ba ji lta bu/ / thar gling gang du nyer 'gro ded dpon bzhin/ /chu gter zab mo'i 'byung gnas bgrod par byed/ /de slad dam pa rnams la bsten par bya/ /dka' thub dpung gnyen dpa' bo rgyal po dang*/ /slob dpon sman pa phan 'dogs grogs kyi dpes/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten la brtson par bya/ /des ni 'di phyir bde legs chos 'grub bo/ /rang la bdog pas nye bar mnyes bya ste/

/chos kyi yon ni gzhal du med pa'i phyir/ /tshogs rdzogs bar chad zhi zhing dpal 'byor ldan/ /byang chub zhi ba myur du thob par 'gyur/ /cung zad phul la khe rngams mi sgrog cing*/ /gzhan du mi bgrang 'gyod par yong mi bya/ /'di phyi'i don chen 'grub pa'i thabs yin phyir/ /legs dgus mchod cing rtag tu bsnyen bkur bya/ /spyod lam mchog gis mnyes par bya ba yang*/ /lus kyis phyag dang bskor ba mchod pa 'bul/ /bar chad bsrung dang mngag gzhug g.yog bya dang*/ /ldang dang gdan 'ding bskur sti sna tshogs bya/ /spang bya'i spyod lam mi gus bag med ni/ /'bru tshugs blta dang bzhin gnyer thal mo rdeb/ /rgyab zur ston dang rkang lag rkyong ba dang*/ /nyal 'phres 'thab 'dzings rtsed 'jo 'jo sgeg byed/ / mchil snabs 'dor dang grib ma 'gong pa dang*/ /bzhud tshe ma gnang mdun 'gros zhabs rjes brdzi/ /lh+wam stan bzhon pa nor rdzas spyod pa dang*/ /sku la tshad 'jal na bza' bzhugs gdan 'gong*/ /ma gus mi shes nyes de spang bar bya/ /ngag kyang snyan pas bstod dang skyabs su 'gro/ /tshig 'jam snyan pas zhe sa rim gror bcas/ /gsung bzhin sgrub cing ci gsung legs zhes brjod/ /gzhan la'ang bla ma'i yon tan brjod bya zhing*/ /dbyangs snyan dad dang bcas pas gsol ba gdab/ /ngag gi mi dge sna tshogs spang bar bya/ /bla ma'i drung du rdzun dang phra ma dang*/ /tshig rtsub ca co ngag 'khyal bre mo'i gtam/ /bka' gcog gdong zlog zhe gcod lkog nas gshe/ /co 'dri la sogs ngag gi sgrib pa spang*/ / yid kyis bla ma'i yon tan dran bya zhing*/ /dad gus chen pos 'phrad dka'i blo bskyed la/ /rjes bzung 'gro ba gzhan la'ang gus par bya/ /ma dad log par lta dang khong khro dang*/ /rtag tu skyon la sems dang brnyas sems dang*/ /'gran sems gnod 'tshe'i sems dang nga rgyal sems/ /mdzad spyod 'gal bar 'dzin dang ma dad sems/ /brnab sems gnod sems log lta'i sems rnams

spang*/ /gsung bzhin rjes su bsgrub pas mchod pa ni/ /thos pa dam pa'i don rnams bsam bya ste/ /nags mthar song nas snying po'i don la 'bad/ /sgrub pas dus 'da' gong ma'i gdung 'tshob bzung*/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam thar bsgrub pa yang*/ /sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan bsam byas la/ /bdag kyang deng nas de yi rjes bslabs te/ /dam pa'i go 'phang thob par byed don du/ /thos bsam bsgom pa'i tshul la nan tan bya/ /de ltar sna tshogs thabs mang nyid sgo nas/ /bla ma bsten pa'i yon tan mtha' yas te/ /yang dag lam chud blang dor dmigs rnam phyed/ /tshogs rdzogs sgrib byang bar chad rab zhi zhing*/ /rang yang skye bo dam pa'i gnas thob nas/ /myur du thar pa'i grong du phyin pa'o/ /theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// // de ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen legs bsten nas/ /sdig pa'i bshes gnyen grogs dang bcas pa spang*/ /de yang nyon mongs shas che rang rgyud ngan/ / tshe 'di don gnyer srid las yid ma byung*/ /thos bsam rgya chung shes bya'i gnas la rmongs/ /dad brtson mi ldan dge tshogs ring du byed/ /sgo gsum ma dul khengs dang bcos pa'i tshul/ /gzhan la gshe zhing dag snang mos gus med/ / zas skom nor dang log pa'i chos la sred/ /sdom dang dam tshig 'chal zhing rang rgyud rtsub/ /'grogs tshad nyon mongs log pa'i lam la 'god/ /mi dge 'phel zhing dge legs 'grib pa ste/ /sdig pa'i bshes gnyen grogs bcas mtshan nyid lags/ /de dang 'grogs pa'i nyes pa tshad med de/ /rang rgyud ngan zhing dag snang chung ba dang*/ /phyogs res khengs shing rang phyogs mchog tu 'dzin/ /bdag bstod gzhan smod yang dag chos spong zhing*/ /theg chen dge ba'i bshes la skur pa 'debs/ /nor rdzas sred cing chags sdang dug mda' 'phen/ /tshe 'di'i dbang gyur thar lam rgyab kyis phyogs/

/dge legs 'grib cing mi dge 'phel ba yin/ /gzhan yang gang dang 'grogs pa de 'go ste/ /gti mug can bsten thos bsam shes rab 'grib/ /zhe sdang can las ma rungs rang rgyud ngan/ /'dod chags can las yul la sred pa 'phel/ /nga rgyal shas che phyogs ris gnyis 'dzin 'ag ོ /phrag dog shas che 'gran sems zug rngu nyid/ /spel ma dang 'grogs nyes kun spel mar 'go /nges 'byung med dang tshe 'dir mngon dga' dang*/ /'dun gros mkhan dang rtsed 'jo 'jo sgeg can/ /che btsan nor la sred dang khe spogs mkhan/ /las byed la sogs gang dang 'grogs gyur de'i/ /kun spyod skal ba ngan pa 'gos par 'gyur/ /rmongs pa dag dang 'grogs pa'i nyes pa yang*/ /shes bya'i gnas la rmongs dang phyogs res khengs/ /thar lam mi shes log pa'i lam bgrod 'gyur/ /dad brtson med dang 'grogs pas dge ba 'grib/ /sgrub la g.yel zhing mos gus nyams par byed/ /theg dman dang 'grogs gcig pu zhi la mos/ /sems stobs chung zhing gzhan don snying rje med/ /theg mchog don dang 'gal ba'i nyes mang ldan/ /lta dang ting 'dzin med dang bslab pa 'chal/ /tha mal rig shes skyong dang rnyed pa 'tshol/ /gnad med gcig pur zhen dang stong lta can/ /nyams med tha snyad mkhan dang 'grogs pa na/ /de dag byur 'go don med tshig phyir 'breng*/ /ne tso'i 'don pa 'dra bar 'gyur ba yin/ /de dag dang 'grogs thar lam bar du gcod/ /dge 'grib bde 'gro'i gnas kyang mi 'grub na/ /zhi bde'i byang chub 'grub pa smos ci dgos/ /des na sdig pa'i grogs po spang bar bya/ /ji ltar lam 'phrang bgrod pa'i mgron po dag /chom rkun 'jigs pas bcom la'ang 'jigs lta na/ /de yis tshe 'di'i nor dang srog 'dor gyi/ /gtan gyi bde ba 'phrog par yong mi nus/ /mi dge'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /dam pas brnyas shing dkar phyogs lhas 'dor bas/ /gnod mang sdug bsngal 'byung gnas 'dir yang phung*/

/phyi mar ngan 'gro gtan du srid mtshor 'khyam/ /bde ba'i nor mchog bral la mi 'jigs pa'i/ /skye bo de ni bdud kyis bslus pa lags/ / 'di ltar 'jig rten na yang rab rtog dpe/ /skyel ma'i yul de bzang ngan rtog cing 'dri/ /thar pa 'dod la bshes gnyen dri rtog med/ /blo gros blun po bdud sdes dngos su bcom/ /dman pa'i nor dag nyo tshong byed na yang*/ /rang gi mi shes gzhan la dri bar byed/ /deng sang gang byung chos kyi lam der 'jug /rnam dpyod mig med thos bsam snang ba mdongs/ /mig ldan gzhan la dri ba'i rtog pa med/ /thar 'dod skye bo mang po bdud kyis bslus/ /'dir ni sdig pa'i grogs po brtags te spang*/ /de yi phan yon dam pa tshad med de/ /log par mi ltung rtag tu dge ba 'phel/ /dam pas bstod cing yon tan tshogs rab 'grub/ / dran dang ting 'dzin shes rab rgya che zhing*/ /'dir yang bde la phyi mar legs pa ste/ /mtho ris gaṅgā'i chu ngogs legs bgrod cing*/ /zhing rnams rgyal sras 'byor pas yongs gang mthong*/ /theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ sdig pa'i grogs po spang ba'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// // de ltar sdig pa'i grogs po spangs byas shing*/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen yongs su bsten pa na/ /de las dang po thos pa'i shes rab bskyed/ /'di ni thar pa'i rtsa ba lags par gsungs/ /de la mang thos yon tan bcu ldan gyi/ /bla ma mchog des skal bzang slob ma la/ /dam pa'i chos ni yongs su 'chad pa na/ / thog mar snod kyi dbang po brtag pa gces/ /byis dang rgan bzhin kha zas tha dad ltar/ /de yi chos kyang rang bzhin tha dad do/ /de nas rim par khrid pa'i tshul gyis bshad/ /des ni theg pa'i rim pa shes pa dang*/ /yon tan gong 'phel 'jigs dngangs skrag pa med/ /nor ba med cing lta spyod zung 'brel 'gyur/ /de ltar ma bshad skyon ni tshad med de/

/gong 'og snga phyi'i rim pa dang bral bas/ /bstan pa'i spyi srol rim pa nyams pa dang*/ /blo chung dngangs skrag log ltas 'dor ba dang*/ /go rim ma shes zab mor mi rtogs dang*/ /'dus byas dge ba khyad du gsod pa dang*/ /sgro skur rgyur 'gyur rgyu 'bras 'chol ba dang*/ / blang dor mi shes shes bya'i don la rmongs/ /theg chen sems bskyed snying rje spangs pa dang*/ /stong lta dang ldan ngan 'graur bslus pa dang*/ /byar med zer nas tha mal lus pa dang*/ /ma smin 'gro la gsang ba sgrog pa ste/ /nyes mang ldan phyir theg pa rim gyis bshad/ /bshad bya'i chos ni theg pa'i rnam grangs dang*/ / blang dor shes bya'i gnas rnams thams cad do/ /dang po'i las can rnams la rgyu 'bras dang*/ /lam zhugs rnams la theg pa'i rnam grangs dang*/ /gzhan don spyod la rig pa'i gnas lnga sogs/ /zab cing rgya che'i rim pa rnams bshad do/ / de yang mi mthun rkyen rnams spang ba ni/ /phyi nang 'du 'dzi bsnyen bkur zang zing dang*/ /chang dang gnyid rmugs dran pa nyams la sogs/ /thos pa'i don la bar chad 'gyur rnams spang*/ /phyogs der khri stan mchod pa sna tshogs dang*/ /maṇḍal la sogs bkod pas brgyan par bya/ /de nas ston pa stan la skyil krung bcas/ /

sems bskyed bskyaid rdzogs ngang la bshad par bya/ /sprul sku'i chos la shākya'i rgyal po dang*/ /longs sku'i gsang sngags rigs lnga rdo rje 'chang*/ /chos sku nam mkha' 'dra ba'i chos rnams la/ /kun bzang shes rab pha rol phyin yum bsam/ /yang na rang rang chos de'i ston par bsam/ /chos kyi tshig don nor 'khrul skyon med par/ /don gsal dbyangs snyan mos pa ji bzhin bshad/ / dbyangs des 'jig rten khams kun khyab gyur te/ /sems can kun thos ma rig sangs par bsam/ /de tshe 'chad pa'i pha rol phyin drug ni/ /tshig don legs bshad chos kyi sbyin pa ste/ /nyon mongs med bshad tshul khrims pha rol phyin/ / skyo ngal bzod pa spro bas brtson 'grus te/ /ma yengs bsam gtan 'byed pa shes rab bo/ /rjes la sems can don du bsngo ba bya/ /bka' drin dran pas dam chos gus pa bskyed/ /de yi phan yon dran dang ting 'dzin dang*/ /nyon mongs rnyog bral spobs pa zad mi shes/ /chos mdzod 'dzin dang bde gshegs chos thos dang*/ /lha mis bstod cing grags dang bsam dgu 'grub/ /tshe rabs kun tu chos dang mi 'bral zhing*/ /myur du bde gshegs chos char 'bebs pa thob/ / theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ 'chad pa po slob dpon gyi le'u ste bcu pa'o// // de nas nyan byed slob ma'i chos tshul ni/ /skyon rnams spangs la gus pas mnyan par bya/ /ma gus la sogs bdud kyi las drug dang*/ /nga rgyal la sogs sgrib pa'i las drug dang*/ /tshul du 'chos sogs chos spang las drug dang*/ /zang zing gnyer sogs g.yeng ba'i skyon drug dang*/ /rnyed bkur chags sogs log pa'i skyon drug dang*/ /gzhan du byed sogs gol ba'i chos drug ste/ /nyes pa sum cu rtsa drug spangs la nyan/ /gang tshe legs pa'i tshul gyis mnyan bya ba/ /nor bu'i 'du shes la sogs gces pa drug /nyon mongs bzod sogs dka' ba'i spyod pa drug

/thos mang gnyer sogs rkyen gyis mi 'gyur drug /snying rje bskyed sogs ched du bya ba drug /bye brag shes sogs dgos pa rnam pa drug /chos 'tshol la sogs bya ba rnam drug ste/ /yon tan sum cu rtsa drug ldan pas nyon/ /mnyan pa'i dus ni gnyen por che dus su/ /dus su 'doms pa'i gdams pa btsal bar bya/ /de yang rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi rnams spangs la/ /chos kyi mchod pa dngos dang yid mchod nas/ /phyag 'tshal drang por 'dug ste thal mo sbyar/ /ma yengs gus pa'i tshul gyis mnyan par bya/ /de yang rang nyid 'jam dpal bsams pa yi/ / snying nang chos kyi 'od zer phog par bsam/ /thos pa'i rnam pa brgyad cu rtsa bzhi dang*/ /ldan byas rab dwang (1) gus pa'i yid kyis mnyan/ /me tog stan sogs dbul ba sbyin pa ste/ /sgo gsum rab bsdams tshul khrims pha rol phyin/ /gnod pa bzod pa spro ba brtson 'grus te/ /ma yengs thos pa 'dzin pa bsam gtan nyid/ /the tshom sgro 'dogs gcod pa shes rab mchog /rjes la chos dang ston pa'i bka' drin bsam/ /sgyu ma'i ngang las byang chub bsngo ba bya/ /de yi phan yon shin tu tshad med de/ /chos rnga bsgrags pa thos pa'i sems can yang*/ /ngan song rnam grol nyan pa smos ci 'tshal/ /shes rab ting 'dzin dran pa'i gzungs thob cing*/ /spang blang mtshams phyed dge 'phel sdig kun srab/ /lha mis bstod cing ma rig mun pa sangs/ /padma'i steng mdzes rgya chen chos thos shing*/ /myur du chos rgyal mya ngan med thob 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ nyan pa po slob ma'i chos kyi le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// // de nas gtan la dbab bya'i chos bstan pa/ /snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus te/ /spang blang dbang gis phyi nang gnyis su bstan/ /dang po phyi rol mu stegs sde pa la/ /ston pa drug dang 'jig tshogs nyi shu dang*/ /drug cu rtsa gnyis sum brgya drug cu dang*/

/sde tshan bcu gcig tarka sde lnga'o/ /ston pa drug ni 'od srungs rdzogs byed dang*/ /gnag lhas bu dang yang dag rgyal ba can/ /lwa ba can dang nog can gnyen gyi bu/ /rang rang lta la chags te kun tu smad/ / gzugs sogs phung lnga bdag ste der bdag gnas/ /bdag las de byung de la bdag dbang sgyur/ /de dag bdag tu rtog pa nyi shu ste/ /yang dag min phyir nyon mongs nyes kun 'dzin/ /rtag par smra sogs sngon mtha' bco brgyad dang*/ /'du shes yod sogs phyi mtha' bzhi bcu bzhi/ /kun kyang tshul min lta la zhugs pas na/ /phyin ci log blo srid pa mdzes byed nyid/ /lo ma can sogs brgya dang nyi shu nyid/ /dus gsum bsgres pas sum brgya drug cu yang*/ /yang dag lam bral rtag chad khor mor 'khyams/ /sde tshan bcu gcig sum brgya drug cu ni/ /sngon dang phyi mtha' da lta gsum phye ste/ /mgo snyoms bcu dang rtag pa ther zug dgu/ /bsnyon smra drug dang bsam gtan dad pa bdun/ /ston pa drug dang blon po rnam pa drug /zhar byung bzhi dang tarka sde drug dang*/ /rgyur lta bzhi dang mkhan po rnam pa gnyis/ /gsang bar smra dang de ltar bcu gcig go /de dag bsdu na rtag chad gnyis yin la/ /rags phra'i 'gyur dang mi ldan don med pas/ /rtag pa med ltar chad pa'ang ga la yod/ /rang bzhin mang ldan rnam grangs de dag nyid/ / grangs can bye brag spyod pa gcer bu pa/ /phur bu pa dang de ltar lnga nyid do/ / grangs can bdag dang gtso bo rnam 'gyur dag /shes pas grol bar smra ba gang de rdzun/ /rang bzhin tha dad 'gal ba nye bar sdud/ /bye brag pa dag shes bya'i don drug gis/ /rnam grol sgrub ste yang dag ma yin nyid/ /khyab 'jug lhar 'dzin rig byed tshad mar smra/ /dam bca' bcu las grol ba sgrub par 'dod/ / de yang rnam grol phan pa'i don med pas/ /phyin ci log gzhung gang de dor bar bya/ /rig byed tshad mar byed las khyad par du/

/gsang tshig grol bar smra ba'i phyogs de ni/ /mkha' ltar khyab bdag khyad par dgu ldan nyid/ /yang dag ma yin kun brtags rgya mtsho'i rlabs/ /brgal dka' srid pa'i chu gter byed de mtshar/ /gcer bu pa dag tshangs pa'i rjes 'gro zhing*/ /rgyal bas bstan de tshad mar byed pa yi/ /tshig gi don bdun du ma gcig par 'dod/ /des ni dam pa'i de nyid spangs pas na/ /srid pa'i nags khrod stug por gnas pa yin/ /phur bu pa dag gzhung lam bdun po la/ /nye bar brten nas nam mkha'i rjes 'gro bas/ /rang gzhan bslu bas 'jig rten kun gnod byed/ /thar pa dam pa'i rjes 'gro rgyal ba'i gzhung*/ /gang dag 'dzin pa de yang rnam pa gnyis/ /theg pa dman dang bla na med pa'o/ /dman pa'ang dbang po'i rim pas rnam pa gnyis/ / nyan thos dang ni rang sangs rgyas pa nyid/ /nyan thos la ni sde tshan rang bzhin dang*/ /grub pa'i mtha' ste rnam pa gsum nyid do/ /phal chen pa dang gnas brtan rab dbye bas/ /sde tshan bco brgyad phyis ni gzhan yang dbye/ /nyan thos lam gang tshul gnas thos dang bsam/ /dge sbyong chos sogs lam dang thar pa dag /thun mong mthun phyir bden pa dgag bya nyid/ /grub pa'i mtha' dag dbye na rnam pa gnyis/ /thun mong pa dang so so'i rim pa'o/ /thun mong 'dod pa rnam pa bdun nyid de/ /dman pa dgag pas 'dir ni rab shes bya/ /so so'i rang bzhin rnam pa gnyis nyid de/ /bye brag pa dang mdo sde spyod pa'o/ /bye brag smra bas shes bya gzhi lnga sogs/ /rnam bdun gzhung gi don rig yang dag min/ /mdo sde spyod pas skyed byed rkyen bzhi sogs/ /rnam bdun tshul de yang dag lta ba min/ / rang sangs rgyas rnams rten 'brel nyid sgo nas/ /yang dag dmigs par rtogs pa'ang gzhan nyid do/ /gangs chen mtsho 'dra sangs rgyas theg pa che/ /go cha mchog sogs bdun gyis 'phags pas na/ /theg pa mkha' 'dra gzhal med khang chen nyid/ /theg mchog rang bzhin tha dad ma mchis kyang*/

/shing rta 'dren byed lta ba gsum nyid las/ /sems tsam rang rgyud thal 'gyur zhes su grags/ / sems tsam pa ni rnam shes don dam 'dod/ /spyi dang khyad par tshul gnyis rim pa las/ /'dod don thun mong rang gsal ye shes dang*/ /kun brtags gzhan dbang yongs grub la sogs nyid/ /don snang shes par 'dod dang mi 'dod las/ /rnam pa bden rdzun gnyis su grags de ni/ /yang dag ma yin kun rtog sbyar ba nyid/ /rang rgyud sde pas bden gnyis dbye ba yis/ /chos rnams yod med spros pa rab 'gog cing*/ /snang ba'i rnam gzhag zhib mor byed de yang*/ / gong 'og rang bzhin rnal don gzhan du 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mthar thug snying po'i don/ /thal 'gyur pas ni spros pa kun 'gog ste/ /chos kun rten 'brel stong nyid rang bzhin med/ /bden gnyis sgyu ma mtha' bral nyid sgo nas/ /lam dang 'bras bu'i chos rnams mthar phyin byed/ /'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa nyid/ /rgyu yi chos las khyad par du mas 'phags/ /gsang sngags che mchog rnam pa bzhi dag las/ /bya ba'i rgyud du bden pa gnyis lta bas/ khrus dang gtsang sbra kun tu spyod pa yis/ /rje khol lta bas dngos grub thob par 'dod/ /spyod pa'i rgyud du gtsang sbra dag dang ni/ /spun grogs tshul gyis dngos grub 'dod pa yin/ /rnal 'byor rgyud du gtsang sbra grogs tsam la/ / sems kyi sgom pa gtso bor 'dod pa ste/ /phyag rgya bzhi dang mngon byang rnam pa lngas/ /rang nyid dam tshig gzhan nas ye shes lha/ /gnyis med bsgoms pas dngos grub thob par 'dod/ /de dag kun kyang bden gnyis res 'jog 'dzin/ /gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu'i khyad par gyis/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i rang bzhin shes par bya/ /rnal 'byor chen pos chos kun mnyam pa'i ngang*/ /dbu ma chen po ro mnyam dag pa las/ /khyad par phung po khams dang skye mched kun/ / dkyil 'khor gcig tu shes pas rnam bsgom ste/

/gang yang thabs mchog rgyal pos grogs su bsgyur/ /bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug bden pa dbyer med nyid/ / bsgoms pas tshe 'dir dngos grub thob par bzhed/ /dbye na pha ma gnyis med rgyud dag las/ /bskyed rim thabs rlung rdzogs rim gtsor 'dod pa/ /rnal 'byor pha rgyud bla na med pa yin/ /rdzogs rim shes rab thig le gtsor 'dod pa/ /rnal 'byor bla med ma yi rgyud ces bya/ /gnyis ka dag mnyam ye shes gtsor 'dod pa/ /gnyis med rgyud sde bla na med pa ste/ /nang pa'i chos kun bsdu na de tsam mo/ /theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ bshad bya chos kyi rnam grangs rgya cher bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// // de ltar thos pa dam pas brgyan rjes su/ /bsam pa'i shes rab nges par rgyud la bskyed/ /de yang thos pa'i don rnams thams cad dang*/ khyad par bsam bya rnam pa lnga nyid las/ /dang po dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa ni/ /mi khom las log mir gyur dbang po tshang*/ /chos ldan yul skyes bzang po'i las 'phro sad/ /las mtha' ma log bstan pa gnas la dad/ /chos ldan grogs mang shin tu rnyed par dka'/ /dang po mi khom las bsam rnyed dka' ni/ /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro tshe ring lha/ /kla klo log lta sangs rgyas kyis stongs pa/ /lkugs pa dang brgyad chos kyi snod ma gyur/ /dug lnga 'khrug dang blun rmongs bdud kyis zin/ /le lo can dang las ngan mtsho chen rdol/ /gzhan dbang 'jigs skyob chos ltar bcos pa ste/ /'phral byung rkyen gyis mi khom rnam pa brgyad/ /thar lam chos kyi snod min phyin ci log /'ching ba dam ldan kun spyod shin tu ngan/ / 'khor bas mi skrag dad pa cung zad med/ /mi dge sdig spyod chos la sems pa med/ /sdom dang dam tshig nyams pa zhes bya ba/ /ris chad blo yis mi khom rnam pa brgyad/ /chos las ring gyur thar lam sgron me nub/

/de dag rnams su bdag cag ma skyes pas/ /spro dga' bskyed de dam pa'i chos sgrub 'tshal/ /'di ltar sems can tsam gyi lus mthong na/ /mi lus thob pa 'khor los sgyur rnyed 'dra/ / mi lus nang nas dad ldan chos kyi rigs/ /de bas dkon phyir sangs rgyas thob dang mtshungs/ /de bas rtag tu dal 'byor bsam 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin dbang po ma tshang mtha' 'khob skyes/ /chos la las med las kyi mtha' log cing*/ / bstan la ma dad chos min sdig pa'i grogs/ /shin tu grangs mang rab tu bsam byas nas/ /de dag ma gyur chos ldan lus rnyed 'di/ /nyin mtshan kun tu nges par bsam par bya/ /chos la spyod pa'i 'byor pa legs tshang pa/ /dkar po'i las 'phro sad par bstan pa yang*/ /mir gyur dbus skyes dbang po tshang zhing dad/ /las mtha' ma log yang dag lta ba can/ /de dag thob dka' las 'phror ldan pa yin/ /gzhan 'byor tshang bas rnyed dka' brtson pa yang*/ /ston byon chos gsungs bstan pa gnas rjes zhugs/ /brtse ldan bshes dang mthun pa'i rkyen 'byor pa/ /rab tu dkon phyir brtson 'grus brtsam 'tshal lo/ /dal 'byor dpes mtshon rnyed par dka' ba yang*/ /mtsho dbus g.yengs pa'i gnya' shing bu ga ru/ /rus sbal mgrin chud srid kyi ngan song las/ /mir gyur rnyed dka' de bzhin rtsig ngos kyi/ /zhal zhal logs la sran ma chags srid kyi/ /mir gyur na yang yul dbus skye ba dkon/ /u dumbā ra 'jig rten 'byung dka' ba/ /de bas chos zhugs yang dag lam 'phrad dkon/ khab mig ras yug chud pa dka' bas kyang*/ /lam rnyed de dag tshul bzhin sgrub pa dkon/ /mtsho gling dag nas nor bu rnyed pas kyang*/ /yang dag bla ma rnyed par dka' bas na/ /de dag bsams la brtson pas sgrub 'tshal lo/ /don med bya ba dor nas sgrub pa yang*/ /thar pa'i rgyur 'gyur dge ba ma gtogs pa/ /gang yang dor nas chos la brtson dgos te/ /'khrul pa'i bya ba don med sdug bsngal rgyu/

/'chi dus mi phan snying po med de'i phyir/ /dug sbrul gzeb bzhin nges par spang 'tshal lo/ /tshe 'di'i so tshis grogs dang gros 'dun dang*/ /longs spyod phyogs ris grub mtha' ngan pa rnams/ /dal 'byor chud gson phung khrol lags pas spang*/ /rtag tu dran dang shes bzhin bag yod pas/ /dal 'byor bsams te thar pa'i byang chub bsgrub/ /'gro nyal 'dug dang zas la sogs pa na'ang*/ /le lo la sogs skyon drug rnam spangs nas/ /mngon mtho nges legs don chen bsgrub pa na/ /bkres pas zas mthong la sogs dpes 'jug ste/ /nyin mtshan kun tu dge la brtson par bya/ /de yi phan yon tshe 'di blos thongs (1) shing*/ /phyi ma don gnyer brtson 'grus me bzhin 'bar/ /dal khom med par dge bas dus 'da' zhing*/ /myur du srid gsum rgya mtsho'i pha rol 'gro /theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba bsam pa'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// // de ltar rnyed dka'i dal 'byor rnyed gyur kyang*/ /skad cig mi rtag 'jig pa'i chos can te/ /srid gsum sgyu ma'i rang bzhin bslu bar 'gyur/ /'di ltar gling bzhi'i 'byor pas brgyan pa yi/ /snod kyi 'jig rten mi rtag 'jig pa'i dpes/ /dbu ba rdos 'dra'i lus kyang shes par gyis/ /da lta'i sa steng 'gro ba 'di kun kyang*/ /lo brgya'i nang du nges par med par 'gyur/ /skyes pa thams cad rim bzhin 'chi bas kyang*/ /bdag gi tshe 'gro 'chi bar 'gyur ba soms/ /

tshong dus bzhi mdo mgron khang gnas rnams su/ /phyogs kyi skye bo 'dus shing 'gyes pa'i dpes/ /'dus pa 'bral zhes snying nas nges par bsam/ /longs spyod 'byor pa phun tshogs dang ldan pa'i/ /grong rnams stongs shing med par gyur pa'i dpes/ /bsags pa 'dzad ces nor rnams gang la yang*/ /mi rtag snying po med pas ma chags bya/ /mtho ris grong gi 'byor pas mngon mtho ba/ /shi ba'i 'og tu ngan 'gror ltung ba'i dpes/ /'byor tshe dregs pas snyems pa med par mdzod/ /phyi nang dus bzhi na tshod 'gyur bas kyang*/ /mi rtag 'chi bar nges kyis rtag 'dzin spongs/ /gzugs ni rdul phran dus ni skad cig ma/ /bar snang glog 'gyu bzhin du mi rtag pas/ /myur ba nyid du dam pa'i chos sgrubs shig /sna tshogs snod dang 'gro ba g.yo 'gyur zhing*/ /sgyu ma chu shing bzhin du snying po med/ / de phyir mi rtag ces byas 'khor ba 'di/ /bdag byas bzung ste btang ba 'ga' yang med/ /'byung bzhi 'dus phyir snod bcud 'jig pa can/ /lus can g.yo ba'i grong khyer rnying par 'gyur/ /mtha' bzhis bsdus phyir rtag pa 'ga' yang med/ /tshe la nges med nam 'chi cha med pas/ /nges par 'chi zhes snying nas bsam par bya/ /'chi bar gyur tshe gnas dang longs spyod dang*/ /gnyen dang dpa' rtsal dpung gnyen la sogs kyis/ /bstongs pa 'ga' med dam pa'i chos sgrubs shig /tshong dus 'gron dang chu 'gram ljon shing dang*/ /'brug sgra sprin dang 'gro ba nyi zla'i 'gros/ /mi rtag g.yo bas myur du 'chi ba soms/ /'chi dus dpung gnyen mchog gsum dge tshogs te/ /dam pa bsten zhing snying po'i don bsgrub 'tshal/ /spyod lam kun tu 'chi ba dran par bya/ /goms pa'i tshad ni 'dus byas 'jig par mthong*/ /brtson ldan 'jigs dang tshe 'di'i bya ba 'dor/ /skad cig tsam yang tha mal mi sdod cing*/ /nges 'byung skyo shas blo sna thung ba 'byung*/

/de yi phan yon shin tu mtha' yas te/ /'khor ba'i nyes spong yon tan ngang gis 'du/ /rtag 'dzin las grol dgra gnyen chags sdang zhig /dge la rab brtson tshe 'di 'khrul par shes/ /tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs grags ldan lhas gzigs shing*/ /bde bar tshe yi dus byed mtho ris 'gro/ /myur du 'chi med bdud rtsi'i go 'phang thob/ /theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ tshe mi rtag par bsam pa'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// // de ltar mi rtag rtogs pa'i rang bzhin rjes/ /gcig tu gces pa dad pa'i dpung tshogs bskyed/ /'dod pa'i dad pas rgyu 'bras blang dor byed/ /mos pa'i dad pas yul mchog sems rab gzhol/ /gus pa'i dad pas bag yod mchog dang ldan/ /dang ba'i dad pas yon tan sems rab dwangs/ /yid ches dad pas chos la the tshom zad/ /nges sems dad pas thos bsam sgom pa yi/ /chos mchog rnams la lhag par dad pa'o/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin sa gzhi bzang po 'dra/ /chos kun gzhir gyur dge tshogs rnam 'phel byed/ /dad pa gzings 'dra srid pa'i chu bo sgrol/ /skyel ma dang 'dra bdud dang nyon mongs skyob/ /bzhon pa dang 'dra thar pa'i gling du 'dren/ /nor bu'i rgyal ltar ci bsam 'grub pa ste/ / dpa' bo dang 'dra sdig to zil gyis gnon/ /tshogs bsags dam pa rnams kyi nor mchog lags/ /skal med rnams la dad pa cung zad med/ /de yi skyon ni shin tu mtha' yas ldan/ /mtsho gting rdo 'dra thar pa'i skam dang bral/ /mnyan med gru 'dra srid las sgrol dus med/ /lag rdum phyin 'dra dge ba'i bgo skal med/ /sa bon 'tshig 'dra byang chub myu gu med/ /long ba dang 'dra chos gzugs snang ba med/ /'khor dong chud 'dra gtan du 'khor bar 'khyams/ /chos dkar dad pa skye ba'i yul drug ni/ /'dod pa'i dad pa srid la skyo bas skye/ /mos pa'i dad pa grogs ngan skyo bas skye/ /gus pa'i dad pa tshe 'dir skyo bas skye/

/dang ba'i dad pa yul mchog dag las skye/ /yid ches dad pa rgyu 'bras thos las skye/ / nges sems dad pa thos bsam dag las skye/ /rgyu la brten nas gong du spel ba yang*/ /dam pa bsten dang dge grogs mdo rgyud bltas/ /'chi ba bsams dang las 'bras yid ches byas/ /thos bsam sgom pa sngar bas brtson pa ste/ /de las dad pa gong 'phel nyid du 'grub/ /'grib pa'i rkyen ni bla ma'i skyon la rtog /tha mal dang 'grogs 'dod yon rang gar spyod/ /le lo snyom las 'jig rten bya ba mang*/ /de dag la sogs chos min las rnams te/ /bdud kyis byin brlabs dus su 'grib par gsungs/ /rkyen las skye ba'i dus su bskyed pa ni/ / skye shi'i 'pho 'gyur mthong dang nad gdon gtses/ /sdug bsngal thog tu babs dang chos thos dang*/ /gong ma'i rnam thar thos dang skyes rabs mthong*/ /de dag rkyen las skyes tshe 'phro mthud la/ /dad pa'i mchog rab rtag tu bsgom par bya/ / tshad ni srid la skyo zhing dkon mchog gus/ /thos bsam don gnyer bslab gsum gces spras byed/ /dge la spro zhing sdig la shin tu 'dzem/ /yon tan gong ma thob pa rnams su bzhed/ /btsal ba'i thabs kyis dad pa ma bskyed na/ /dge legs mi 'grub gtan du srid par 'khyams/ /de phyir gang dang gang la brten nas kyang*/ /dad pa bskyed pa'i thabs la 'bad par bya/ /dad pa'i gol sa shes nas spang ba ni/ /dam pa'i drung du dad las gzhan du min/ /cung zad rkyen gyis 'phel dang 'grib pa can/ /rkyen ngan sol nas dad pa cung zad med/ /blo mang gang la'ang 'jug la thang mi thub/ /gcig tu ma nges gang bder spyod pa can/ / gtad med bab col phra mo'i rkyen gyis zlog /'di drug spangs la blo gtad rgyun du bya/ /dang po (1) rab brtags dad pa'i yul rnams la/ /phyi nas mi 'gyur ri rgyal lta bu dang*/ /'phel dang 'grib med nyi mkha' rgya mtsho la/ /thang lhod gnyis med gzhu mo'i rgyud dang mtshungs/

/skyo dub med pa gru zam lta bu la/ /rgyun chad med pa chu bo'i gzhung chen bzhin/ /mnyen lcug ldan pa dar thag lta bu la/ /rkyen gyis mi 'phrogs nam mkha' lta bur bsten/ /dad pa'i phan yon rnam grangs dpag tu med/ /dkar po'i chos kun gzhir gyur sdug bsngal sel/ /byang chub lam 'dren zab mo'i snod du gyur/ /dam pas dgongs shing yon tan phun tshogs ldan/ /de phyir skye bo dam pa'i tshul dge bas/ /dad brgya'i 'dab stong rgyas la nan tan mdzod/ /theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ dad pa'i rang bzhin bsam pa'i le'u ste bco lnga pa'o// // de nas dad ldan rnams kyis bsam bya ba/ /rgyu 'bras las te dge sdig blang dor bya/ /dge ba'i las ni bsod nams cha mthun dang*/ /thar pa cha mthun rnam pa gnyis dag las/ /srid pa'i bde 'bras bskyed pa'i dge ba rnams/ / bsod nams cha mthun lags par thub pas gsungs/ /rnam grangs mang yang bsdu na dge ba bcu/ /lus gsum ngag bzhi yid kyi gsum dag ste/ /'di bcu bsam gtan gzugs med ma 'brel bas/ /'dod pa'i lha mi'i bde 'bras bskyed pa nyid/ /bsam gtan gzugs med dang 'brel gong ma gnyis/ /dge bas bde 'gro bde ba'i rigs kun bskyed/ / srog gcod spangs pas tshe ring nad med cing*/ /ma byin len spangs 'byor pa phun sum tshogs/ /log par g.yem spangs khyim thab dgra zla med/ /rdzun du smra spangs gzhan gyis bstod pa dang*/ / rtsub mo rnams spangs snyan par smra bas bde/ /phra ma rnams spangs mthong na mi mthun med/ /'khyal pa spangs pas tshig bzung 'os par 'gyur/ /brnab sems spangs pas re ba 'grub pa ste/ /gnod sems spangs pas yid 'ong mthong na zhi/ /log lta spangs pas lta ba bzang ba ste/ /mtho ris bgrod pa'i shing rta dge ba bcu/ /mngon mtho bde 'dod rnams kyis dang du long*/ /mi dge'i las bcu ngan song sdug bsngal rgyu/

/che 'bring chung ngus dmyal ba yi dwags dang*/ /dud 'gror ltung 'gyur sna tshogs sdug bsngal ldan/ /mtho ris thob kyang de yi sdug bsngal 'grub/ /srog bcad pas ni tshe thung nad mang zhing*/ /ma byin blangs pas dbul zhing phongs par 'gyur/ /log par g.yem pas khyim thab dgra zlar bcas/ /rdzun du smras pas skur pa mang 'gyur zhing*/ /phra mas bshes bral phan tshun mi mthun 'gyur/ /rtsub mos mi snyan 'khyal pas ngag mi btsun/ /brnab sems yid la re ba mi 'grub cing*/ /gnod sems 'jigs bcas log ltas lta ngan nyid/ /de ltar mi dge bcu po dug 'dra bas/ / sems shes rnams kyis rab tu spang 'tshal lo/ /thar pa'i lam ni zhi ba byang chub bsgrub/ /srid las 'da' byed sdug bsngal spong bar byed/ /gang zhig theg pa gsum gyi lam zhugs pa'i/ /'gro ba rnams kyis legs par bsgrub pa ni/ / so so'i sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom zhing*/ /phar phyin drug spyod byang chub phyogs chos bsgrub/ /nyin mtshan brtson pas dge bar gyur rnams yin/ / khyad par theg chen dge ba rlabs po che/ /sbyor ba sems bskyed dngos gzhi dmigs pa med/ /rjes la bsngo bas yongs su zin pa ni/ /thar lam bgrod pa'i gces pa rnam gsum nyid/ /rtsom pa thams cad gzhan don 'ba' zhig spyod/ lta ba mkha' 'dra stong nyid bco brgyad dang*/ /sgom pa 'od gsal phyogs chos sum cu bdun/ /spyod pa skyon med pha rol phyin pa drug /'bras bu bla med byang chub 'grub pa yin/ /'di ltar snang srid 'khor ba'i chos rnams kun/ /dge dang mi dge'i bag chags las byung ste/ /las ma zad par 'khrul snang stongs mi srid/ /de yi phyir na mi dge spang bar bya/ /dag pa'i rgyal sras lam gyi yon tan dang*/ /rnam grol rgyal ba'i 'byor pa phun tshogs kun/ /tshogs gnyis bsags pas khams la sgrib gnyis bral/ /dge tshogs las byung shes nas 'bad par mdzod/

/dge ba'ang bsod nams cha mthun 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /de las log ste thar pa cha mthun bsgrub/ /'khor ba spang phyir de rgyu spang 'tshal lo/ /pha rol phyin lnga snang bcas bsod nams dang*/ /shes rab ye shes tshogs gnyis bsten par mdzod/ /theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ las rgyu 'bras bsam pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// // de nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam bya ste/ /snying po med cing rtag mi thub pa'i phyir/ khams gsum rigs drug srid pa'i sdug bsngal las/ /myur du 'da' ba'i thabs la 'bad par bya/ /dmyal ba'i gnas na sdug bsngal dpag tu med/ /yang sos phan tshun mtshon gyis 'debs pa las/ /yang yang skye shi'i sdug bsngal bzod glags med/ /thig nag lcags kyi sog les gshog pa ste/ / bsdus 'joms ri dang gtun dang ljongs su 'thag /ngu 'bod lcags khyim 'bar bar sreg byed cing*/ /ngu 'bod chen po lcags khyim nyis rim sreg /tsha ba mdag me 'bar ba'i sa gzhi la/ /pags pa bshus te phur bus rgyong pa dang*/ /rab tu tsha ba phyi nang mes gdung zhing*/ /zangs zhun khol mas lus kun rdul du sreg /mnar med lcags khang 'bar bas bzod glags med/ /rdung dang 'tshog dang gshog dang phye mar 'thag /'tshed dang 'bigs dang lcags leb 'bar bas dkri /phyi rol phyogs bzhir nye 'khor bcu drug ste/ /ro myags 'dam dang chu bo rab med dang*/ /spu gri'i thang dang ral gri lo ma'i tshal/ /shal ma'i sdong pos kun nas 'khor ba la/ /dmyal ba pa rnams sdug bsngal sna tshogs spyod/ /tshe tshad yang sos la sogs drug po ni/ /'dod lha'i tshe dang nyin zhag mnyam pa yi/ /rang lo de snyed bar du thub pa ste/ /rab tu tsha bas bar bskal phyed thub cing*/ / mnar med bar bskal gcig tu gnas par gsungs/ /gangs dang kha ba'i bu yug langs pa yis/ /rab tu sbrebs pa'i lus can rnam brgyad ni/ /chu bur can dang chu bur rdol ba can/

/a chu zer dang kyi hud so 'thams dang*/ /padma ltar gas utpal padma che/ /grang bas nyam thag sdug bsngal pha mtha' yas/ /tshe tshad khal brgya shong ba'i til sbyangs nas/ /lo brgyar til gcig phyung bas zad gyur pa/ /chu bur can tshe lhag ma nyi shur 'gyur/ /yi dwags bkres skom 'tshe bas sdug bsngal ba/ /phyi yi sgrib can bzang dgu mthong na'ang bskams/ /nang gi sgrib can glo snying mer 'bar zhing*/ /spyi mthun sgrib can zas skom yid la btags/ /bcu gnyis lor yang chu yi sgra mi thos/ /gzhan gyis 'tshe dang bsrung bar snang ba'o/ /tshe tshad mi yi lo brgya yi dwags zhag /rang lo lnga brgyar sdug bsngal myong ba yin/ /dud 'gro rnams la'ang gcig gis gcig za zhing*/ /'tshe dang bkol spyod gsod gcod sdug bsngal mang*/ /tshe la ma nges bskal pa la sogs so/ /mi rnams la yang bde ba'i skabs med de/ /skye rga na 'chi dgra dang 'tshe ba mang*/ /bshes bral 'dod pas phongs dang mi 'dod myong*/ /'dod pa ma grub tsha grang ngal dub dang*/ /phan pa'i lan du gnod dang drin mi gzo/ /'khor gyis log sgrub don med phrag dog dang*/ /mi bsngags don med sgro skur dpag tu med/ /lha min rnams la'ang khro dang 'khrug pa dang*/ /mi 'dod thog tu 'bab dang 'chi la sogs/ /sna tshogs sdug bsngal mang ldan bde ba med/ /lha rnams la yang 'chi 'pho ltung la sogs/ / sdug bsngal chu mtsho mtha' yas dpag tu med/ /de ltar 'khor ba me yi 'obs 'dra ste/ /bde ba'i skabs med zo chun 'khyud mo bzhin/ /gcig nas gcig brgyud thog tha med pa las/ /blo bzang rnams kyis thar phyir spro ba bskyed/ /snying po med pa de 'dra'i 'khor ba las/ / thar pa'i mchog ni mya ngan 'das pa ste/ /zhi bde bsil ba'i bdud rtsi bla na med/ /rtag brtan 'pho 'gyur med cing spros dang bral/ /yon tan rang bzhin lus rdzogs rga shi med/ /sgrib bral rnyog pa med cing phan bde'i gnas/
