/'gro ba'i skyabs dang dpung gnyen gyur pa der/ /blo bzang rnams kyis bgrod phyir brtson par bya/ /theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal du rtog cing myang 'das bde bar bsam pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o// // de ltar bsam bya yongs su rdzogs pa na/ /sgom byung shes rab rgyud la bskyed par bya/ /theg gsum nges par 'byung ba'i lam gsum las/ /'dir ni bla med snying po'i don la 'jug /de la dang po gnas lugs shes pa gces/ / theg pa'i dbang gis rnam pa mang na yang*/ /nges pa'i snying po bden pa dbyer med de/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsang ba'i mdzod khang yin/ /de yi rang bzhin 'od gsal ye shes te/ /thog ma med nas rab zhi spros med bdag /nyi mkha' bzhin te lhun grub 'dus ma byas/ /rang bzhin rnam dag chen por ye gnas pas/ /snang stong dbyer med grub bsal 'gro 'ong med/ /kun rdzob rnam chad rnam dbye'i yul 'das pas/ /brtags pa'i bden gnyis 'das phyir spros kun zhi/ / bden pa dbyer med grub dang ma grub med/ /dbyings la snang stong rang bzhin gnyis med pas/ /bden pa de yang dbyer med ces su brjod/ /tha snyad bden gnyis tshul gyis rab dbye na/ /'di ltar 'khrul snang 'khor ba'i chos rnams kun/ /mi bden bslu phyir kun rdzob bden pa lags/ /zab zhi 'od gsal mya ngan 'das pa'i chos/ /'gyur med rang bzhin don dam bden par 'dod/ /kun rdzob 'di ltar sna tshogs snang ba 'di/ /sgyu ma chu zla sprul pa gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /rang bzhin med la snang ba gang yin 'di/ /shin tu brtags na gzhi rtsa dngos med pas/ /mkha' 'dra stong zhing mtshan nyid chad pa ste/ /ma brtags nyams dga' sna tshogs sgyu ma bzhin/ /bag chags 'khrul pa'i rten 'brel las byung ba/ /ji ltar dha du ra yi snang ba bzhin/ /'di ltar rang bzhin stong la bdag med pa/

/de nyid de yi gnas lugs yin pa'i phyir/ /don dam zhes bya snang cha kun rdzob ste/ /snang dus nyid nas skye sogs grub med pas/ /rang bzhin de yin bden pa dbyer med do/ /de yi rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa dang*/ /'od gsal don dam gnyis su byar med pas/ /'khor 'das gnyis med bden pa dbyer med do/ /'di ltar snang yang 'khor ba ma grub pas/ /rang bzhin med de dbyings kyi don dam dang*/ /tha dad so sor dbye ba'i chos med pas/ /'khor 'das dbyer med mnyam pa nyid du bstan/ /'di las gzhan du rtog pa log pa'i blo/ /gnas lugs don la rab tu rmongs pa yin/ /'khrul ngor ji ltar snang bzhin rgyu 'bras yod/ /de phyir dge sdig blang dor shes pa gces/ /'gyur med don dam bden pa'i rang bzhin ni/ /'od gsal bde gshegs snying po lhun grub ste/ /stong gsal rig pa dbyer med chos nyid do/ /'di nyid rang bzhin lhun grub dkyil 'khor te/ /ye nas lhun rdzogs byang chub snying po can/ /rnam dag spros bral phyogs lhung kun dang bral/ /zab zhi sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med/ /

'di nyid 'gro ba kun la yod pa'i dpe/ /sa 'og gter dang bum nang mar me dang*/ /pad nang sku 'drar mkhas pas shes par bya/ /ji ltar dbul po'i sa 'og rin chen gter/ /rang la yod kyang ma shes phongs pa ltar/ /lhun grub sangs rgyas rang la yod gyur kyang*/ /lus ngag sems te tshogs brgyad sas bsgribs pas/ /srid pa'i nyes tshogs dbul bas rgyun du phongs/ /de las lha yi mig ldan mis mthong nas/ /gter de 'byin pa'i thabs bstan des phyung bas/ /rang bzhin 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa ltar/ /dam pa rnams kyis gnas lugs de bstan pas/ /ji bzhin bsgrubs pas sangs rgyas rang las rnyed/ /don gnyis phun tshogs yid bzhin nor bur 'gyur/ /ji ltar bum nang sgron me 'od gsal yang*/ /bum pas bsgribs te phyi rol mi mngon ltar/ /snying po'i chos sku rang la gnas na yang*/ /sgrib pa'i bum pas bsgribs phyir yongs mi snang*/ /de las bum pa bcag na snang ba ltar/ /sa rnams sgrib pa gang yin bral ba na/ /'jig rten sgron me kun tu snang bar byed/ /ji ltar pad nang bde gshegs sku yod kyang*/ /padmas gtums phyir phyi rol snang ba med/ /de bzhin gzung 'dzin 'dab stong gis bsgribs pas/ /rang gsal rgyal ba'i dbang po mthong mi nus/ /nam zhig 'dab ma kha phye gsal ba ltar/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul snang 'dab ma las grol tshe/ /byang chub sku gsum rang la snang bar 'gyur/ /de phyir chos dbyings don dam 'od gsal ni/ /rang la yod pa'i gnas lugs shes par mdzod/ / 'di la ming gi rnam grangs mang yod de/ /'khor 'das 'byung bas dbyings zhes rab brjod cing*/ /ye nas yod pas rang bzhin lhun grub ces/ /dri mas bsgribs phyir snying po'i khams dang ni/ /gnas lugs yin phyir don dam bden pa dang*/ /gdod nas dag phyir 'od gsal dri med nyid/ /mtha' gnyis gnas bsal dbu ma'i rang bzhin dang*/ /spros las 'das phyir shes rab pha rol

phyin/ /stong gsal rnam dag bden pa dbyer med dang*/ /'pho 'gyur med pas chos nyid de bzhin nyid/ /la sogs mig ldan mkhas pa rnams bzhed do/ /tshul 'di mi shes stong pa phyang chad pa/ /tshig tu yod med mtha' bral zhes smra yang*/ / bral gzhi mi shes srid rtse'i lta ba can/ /bstan pa 'di las phyi rol gyur pa'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i yid can thal bas byugs pa rung*/ /gang 'dir ston pas chos kyi mdzod gsungs pa/ /kun gyi snying po 'od gsal rtse mo'i lam/ /lhun grub gzhi yi gnas lugs 'di zhes bya/ /yang zab lta ba'i mthar thug 'di shes pas/ /gol sgrib las grol rtag chad kun dang bral/ /bsgrub pa don yod myur du 'tshang rgya zhing*/ /mdo rgyud kun la lta ba'i mig dang ldan/ /de phyir gnas lugs 'od gsal mkhyen par mdzod/ /theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa'i le'u ste bco brgyad pa'o// // de ltar gnas lugs shes nas bsgom par bya/ /de la thog mar sngon du 'gro ba ni/ /skyabs su 'gro zhing byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /gsang sngags phyi nang bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom/ /skyabs 'gro'i yul ni dkon mchog gsum nyid de/ /rgyu yi yul gyur gzhan rgyud byon zin pa'i/ /sangs rgyas sku gsum spangs rtogs 'phrin las ldan/ /chos ni 'gog lam bden pa rnam pa gnyis/ /dge 'dun sar bzhugs rgyal sras 'phags rnams te/ /gnas skabs de gsum mtshungs par skyabs su 'gro/ /mthar thug sangs rgyas chos sku nyag gcig ste/ / dkon mchog mthar thug skyabs kyi dam pa nyid/ /lam bden kun rdzob rgyal sras sgrib bcas phyir/ /sangs rgyas nyid las mthar thug skyabs gang zhig / 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro dkon mchog rnam pa gsum/ /rang la 'grub 'dod slad du smon pa yin/ / de yang rgyu yi skyabs 'gros rgyu byas te/ /rang rgyud dkon mchog 'bras bu'i skyabs 'grub 'dod/

/sangs rgyas ston pa chos la lam dang ni/ /dge 'dun grogs kyi tshul du skyabs su 'gro/ /de ltar skyabs yul shes nas skyabs 'gro ba/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar dkon mchog rab bsams la/ /dngos dang yid kyi mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad thal sbyar te/ / gsum la phyogs pas skyabs su 'gro bar bsam/ /bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /lan gsum bar du skyabs su 'gro bar bya/ / de yi phan yon gnas skabs bsam pa 'grub/ /nang par tshud dang chos kun rten du 'gyur/ / gnod pas mi brdzi sangs rgyas zhabs drung skye/ /mthar thug don gyi dkon mchog gsum po 'grub/ /de phyir thog mar skyabs su 'gro bar bya/ /de nas byang chub sems mchog bskyed pa ni/ /gzhan kyi don phyir sangs rgyas 'dod pa ste/ / smon dang 'jug pa'i rang bzhin gnyis yin no/ /sems bskyed pas ni sems byung zhar la bskyed/ /sems ni don gyi ngo bo rang stobs rig /sems byung don gyi khyad par rang stobs rig /'khor ba'i dus na sems dang sems byung gis/ / bya dang byed pa rnam par g.yo bas na/ /ye shes mi snang phyir na sems bskyed de/ /ye shes rab gsal don la nus pa 'jog /rgyun mthar sems 'gag des bskyed cho ga las/ /nye bar thob pa'i sems bskyed ldog na yang*/ /de yis nus ldan ye shes la bgos pa/ /sangs rgyas sar rgyas thugs rjes don mdzad la/ / sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed ces byar brjod/ / tshogs dang sbyor bar khams de'i rang bzhin nyid/ /mos pas don spyi'i tshul du 'jal bas na/ / sems bskyed de yang mos pas byung zhes brjod/ /dang po'i sa nas bdun pa'i bar nyid du/ khams kyi sgrib pa phyogs re rnam dag pas/ /ye shes rgya che lhag bsam dag ces brjod/ /dag pa'i sar ni sgo lnga kun gzhi'i shes/ /rnam dag smon lam yon tan rgya che bas/ /rnam par smin pa'i sems bskyed ces su brjod/

khams la sgrib bral sangs rgyas sa de ni/ /sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed ces byar brjod/ / ji ltar bskyed tshul rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /bla ma mchog dang dkon mchog drung du len/ /bla mar len tshe de yis chos bshad de/ /sngon 'gro yan lag bdun pa skyabs 'gror bcas/ /dngos gzhi rgyal dang de sras bla ma mchog / dgongs su gsol zhes legs par brjod rjes su/ /ji ltar sngon gyi rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ /byang chub thugs bskyed bslab la gnas pa ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sems bskyed bslab la gnas par bgyi/ /de skad ces ni lan gsum brjod par bya/ /de yi phan yon dam pa tshad med de/ /rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i ming thob cing*/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten kun gyi mchod sdong 'gyur/ /dge ba thams cad thar pa'i lam 'gyur zhing*/ /sdig pa mtha' yas nyes zad bsod nams 'phel/ /thar lam rnyed cing mngon mtho nges legs 'grub/ /de ltar sems mchog bskyed par gyur ma thag/ gsang sngags rjes zhugs skal bzang 'gro mchog gis/ /rang rang mos pa'i yi dam lhar bsgom mo/ /sngon du rig gtad rjes gnang dbang la sogs/ /rgyud sde mchog las gsungs bzhin smin byas la/ /grol byed bskyed rdzogs don la bsgom par bya/ /'di ltar phyi snod zhing dang sems can lha/ /rang lus gzhal yas khang mdzes ngag sngags te/ /sems ni lhar gsal tha mal zhen pa 'gog / dbyings kyi rjes 'gro sgrib pa'i dri ma sel/ /de rjes sems nyid mi dmigs chos nyid ngang*/ /sems nyid 'od gsal rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom/ /'di ni nges don rgyud sde'i dgongs pa yin/ /theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin ṛn po che'i mdzod las/bsam gtan gyi sngon du 'gro ba'i le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o// // de nas dngos gzhi ji ltar bsgom pa ni/ /dang po dben zhing yid 'ong gnas dag tu/

/sngon 'gro'i chos rnams rim par rdzogs ma thag /dngos gzhi 'od gsal ye shes bsgom par bya/ /de yang thabs med shes rab mi skye bas/ / thog mar sna tshogs thabs kyis bsam gtan btsal/ /dmigs pa'i rten las mi dmigs skye ba ste/ /de las chos nyid ye shes 'char bas na/ /dang po zhi gnas bskyed pa'i rim pa yang*/ /rang rang rgyud las ji skad gsungs bzhin bsgom/ /'dir ni mdor bsdus cung zad bstan pa ni/ /lus la rtsa gnas de la rlung dang khams/ /rang bzhin brten phyir de dag gnad bsnun gces/ /lus kyi cha bsrangs rdo rje skyil krung la/ /lag pa pus bkab mjing pa cung zad dgye/ / dbugs ni thad so mig ni 'gul mi bya/ /rlung ro phyir gdon 'jam rlung nang du bzung*/ /rlung ni kha sbyar rtsa gsum 'khor lo gsal/ kha dog grangs dang reg bya dbyibs bsgoms pas/ /rnam rtog rang 'gag gsal dngas phyed par gnas/ / mi rtog ye shes ngo sprad lhag mthong bsgom/ / de nas khams la bslab pa'i rim pa yang*/ /a shad me yis ri bong can bzhu bas/ /bde chen ngang la mi rtog sbyangs rjes su/ /'khor lo bzhi dbus rtsa gsum steng 'og las/ /nyi zla'i 'gros can dbu mar mnyam zhugs te/ /dbus su rnam 'dres e waṃ zung 'jug ni/ /lnga ldan ches phra 'od gsal ngang nyid las/ / mchog rab rnams la nam mkha'i gzugs can te/ /gzhan la mi rtog zhi gnas 'grub pa yin/ /mdo dang bstan bcos dag las rlung dang ni/ /phyi rol dmigs pa'i rten la sems bzung bas/ /zhi gnas bsgrub dang 'di ni mtshungs par bstan/ /thabs des 'grub pa'i lhag mthong ye shes ni/ /gsal bde'i ngang der gnas dang mi gnas dang*/ /yod med yin min mtshon brjod 'das pa'i mdangs/ /rang rig spros bral dwangs gsal lhag ge ba/ /rgya chad phyogs med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /dwangs gsal mi g.yo nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ / kun rtog rnyog bral rgya mtsho lta bu des/

/rang byung ye shes sems nyid 'od gsal du/ /dam pa rnams kyis ngo sprod (1) chos kyi sku/ /lhan cig skyes te rtag tu bsgom par bya/ /mtshan ma'i rnam rtog gang dang gang shar yang*/ /gnas lugs ngang der chu la rlabs bzhin grol/ /glod pas rang zhi ngang dngas ma shor gces/ /ma bying ma rmugs rgod par ma gyur cing*/ /ma chags mi g.yo rgyu ba kun dang bral/ / bsam gtan dwangs pas shes rab rgyun chad med/ /rang byung ye shes lhan cig skyes pa bsgom/ /'di ni yang zab snying po'i gdams pa yin/ /de las spyan dang mngon shes skye 'gyur zhing*/ /nyin mtshan ting 'dzin phyad par grol ba dang*/ / gzungs sprin ye shes nyi ma khong nas 'char/ /rtsa rlung las rung yon tan tshogs 'phel bas/ /sa rnams gong bgrod grub pa rnam gnyis thob/ /de phyir 'di 'dra'i gnad la goms par mdzod/ /gang la gnad med spros bral tshig tu shor/ /rtog pa'i bzo rgyas mtha' bral gdeng bcas te/ /rnam rtog ci skyes skye 'gag grangs 'debs kyang*/ /gnas lugs don dang rgyang ring gnam sa 'bazhin/ /zang thal chig rdzogs 'brel thag chad pa yi/ /sal le hrig ge bar mtshams ngos bzung nas/ /don mthong 'dod pas don med phyin ci log /skad cig yud tsam ngos bzung 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /snga phyi sgom min bar der su yis bcug /de 'dra'i lam ngan mdo rgyud dang 'gal bas/ /thar pa 'dod na ring du spang bar bya/ /rab kyis sor gzhug 'bring gis ngang la bskyang*/ /tha mas so sor rtsal sbyang zhes smra ba/ /mun pa'i blo can sngon med glang chen zhig /gzhung lugs kun las mi rtog ye shes mchog /zab zhi spros bral gnas lugs bsgom par gsungs/ /de dang 'gal gyur lam ngan ji snyed pa/ /deng sang dar bas thar 'dod rnams kyis spang*/ /mnyam gzhag dngos gzhi'i ngang las langs ma thag / sgyu mar shes pas gzhan don bsngo bar bya/ /rjes snang snang srid dkyil 'khor shes bya ste/

/sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad tshul gyis spyad par bya/ /theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ 'od gsal mchog gi bsgom pa bstan pa'i le'u ste nyi shu pa'o// // de ltar bsgom pas bgrod pa'i sa lam yang*/ /phyi nang sbyar te legs par bshad pa ni/ /tshogs dang sbyor mthong sgom pa'i lam bzhi po/ /yongs su rdzogs pas sangs rgyas 'grub de'i phyir/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu rtsa bdun ni/ / dkyil 'khor dag gi'ang rnam dag chos su gsungs/ /'khor lo bzhi po'i rlung sems las rung tshe/ /lam bzhi'i yon tan rim bzhin 'char ba ste/ /dbu ma'i rtsa mdud gnyis gnyis grol ba las/ /sa bcu'i yon tan nang nas 'char bar bzhed/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lor rlung sems las rung bas/ /tshogs lam gsum po'i drod rtags 'char ba ste/ /sangs rgyas sprul sku'i zhal mthong sprul pa 'gyed/ /tshogs lam chung ngur dran pa nyer gzhag ste/ /lus lhar bskyed pa lus dran nye bar gzhag /byung tshor rnam rtog ye shes bsgyur ba ni/ /tshor ba dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ste/ /sems dang sems byung spros pa nyer zhi'i bsgom/ /sems dran nyer gzhag rdzogs pa'i rim pa ste/ /snang btags chos kun sgyu mar shes pa ni/ /chos dran nyer gzhag lags par rgyud las gsungs/ /'bring du yang dag spong bzhi'i rim pa ni/ /de ltar bsgom pas dge dang mi dge yi/ /zhen pa bzhi po yang dag spong ba ste/ /mi dge'i chos rnams ma skyes mi bskyed cing*/ /skyes pa gzhom phyir 'bad rtsol brtson 'grus brtsam/ /dge ba'i chos rnams ma skyes bskyed pa ste/ /skyes pa spel phyir 'bad rtsol brtson 'grus brtsam/ /chen por rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi bsgom pa yang*/ /bskyed rdzogs don la ma yengs rtse gcig tu/ / dran dang 'dun dang dpyod dang sems rnams kyi/ /ting 'dzin skyon med zhi ba bsgom pa las/ /rlung sems las rung rdzu 'phrul legs grub nas/

/dag pa'i zhing bgrod sprul skur chos rab nyan/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i rlung sems las rung bas/ /sbyor ba'i lam gyi yon tan 'char ba ni/ /dad brtson dran pa ting 'dzin shes rab kyi/ /dbang po lnga nyid drod rtser bsgoms pa yis/ /rmi lam sgyu ma'i rang bzhin 'byongs pa dang*/ /bden pa'i tshig grub sbyangs pa'i yon tan ldan/ / lus kyi shig sro 'bu srin med pa yin/ /stobs lnga'i rang bzhin bzod pa chos mchog bsgom/ /ngan song rnams chad dge rtsa brtan pa dang*/ /ting 'dzin rdzu 'phrul sngon las mchog tu 'phags/ /longs spyod 'khor lo'i rlung sems las rung bas/ /rnam par mi rtog bden mthong mthong lam gyi/ /yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis dbang sgyur zhing*/ /longs sku'i zhing bgrod rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas mthong*/ /dran dang ting 'dzin shes brtson btang snyoms dga'/ /shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi/ /yan lag bdun po dag kyang rdzogs par 'gyur/ / bde chen 'khor lo'i rlung sems las rung bas/ /sgom lam sa dgu'i yon tan 'char ba ste/ /dri med 'od 'phro 'od byed chung ngu gsum/ /sbyang dka' mngon gyur ring song 'bring po gsum/ /mi g.yo legs blo chos sprin chen po gsum/ /de dag so so'i yon tan rlabs che ba/ /stong phrag bcu gnyis la sogs rgya chen

te/ /rtsa 'dab phra mo'i mdud pa rab grol bas/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin nyon mongs rlung sems nub/ /mya ngan 'das zhi ye shes rlung mchog 'phel/ /de ltar sa bcu'i bgrod pa de dag las/ /dbu mar ro rkyang mdud pa nyi shu gcig / gnyis gnyis grol bas sa bcu re re thob/ /tha mas gtsug tor rtse mo'i sa mchog 'grub/ /gang tshe gong ma'i rtogs par phyin gyur cing*/ /sangs rgyas bar du bgrod pa de dag la/ /yon tan 'di dag nyi dang zer bzhin no/ /kha cig sa lam yon tan drang don zer/ /la la rtogs pa thob kyang yon tan med/ /yod dang cha gnyis 'dod pa rmongs pa'i blo/ /rang gi lta la chags shing zhen byas nas/ /ma nor chos la skur ba 'debs 'di spang*/ /'dir ni lam bsgoms pa las yon tan tshogs/ /dbyar kha'i me tog bzhin du rnam 'phel zhing*/ /sa lam bgrod nas sangs rgyas 'dod de'i phyir/ /sku dang ye shes nor bu dang 'dra yang*/ /bem po'i dper min rtog med lhun grub las/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba srid rtse'i bar du khyab/ /'di ni mdo rgyud dgongs pa mthun par gsungs/ /theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ lam bgrod pa'i sa mtshams bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer gcig pa'o// // de ltar bsgoms pas dag pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /spangs rtogs mthar phyin sku dang ye shes te/ /ji ltar nyi zla sprin dang bral ba bzhin/ khams kyi sgrib pa kun dang bral ba na/ /byang chub ces bya lhun grub yon tan snang (1) / /lus dang don dang yul du snang ba yi/ /sgrib pa'i bag chags gsum po rab grol te/ /bum chag mar me padma kha bye'i sku/ /lhun grub yon tan rdzogs te mngon sum snang*/ / sgrib gsum bag chags so sor grol ba las/ /zhing dang ye shes rgyal ba'i skur snang ste/ /ji snyed ji bzhin gzigs pa rnam dag yin/ /chos kyi sku dang longs spyod rdzogs pa dang*/ /sprul pa'i sku rnam mkha' dang nyi bzhin dang*/

/de yi gzugs brnyan dngas ba'i mtshor snang bzhin/ /bsam gyis mi khyab bde chen ye shes sku/ /kun gyi bdag ste zag med mtshon brjod 'das/ /ngo bo nyid sku khyab bdag chos nyid de/ /bde chen nyid las gzhan zhig yod ma yin/ /mngon byang mi 'gyur rdo rje'i bdag nyid sku/ /spangs rtogs mthar phyin 'pho 'gyur med pa yin/ /de ltar sku rnams dbyer med dbyings gcig ste/ /'od gsal snying po sgrib kun bral ba nyid/ /stong dang snang dang 'phro dang dbyer med pas/ /tha dad brjod kyang brda tsam btags pa nyid/ /de la brten pa'i ye shes rnam lnga yang*/ / chos dbyings me long mnyam nyid so sor rtog /bya grub ye shes rang bzhin lhun grub ste/ /dang po chos sku gnyis pa longs sku'i bdag /gsum pa bde chen lhag ma sprul sku ste/ /ngo bo dbyer med ldog pa tha dad nyid/ /mdzad pa'i phrin las sprul sku'i rol pa ste/ /gang la gang 'dul de la der snang zhing*/ /mos pa'i rjes 'gro blo dang 'tshams par 'byung*/ /srid pa ji srid phan bde mdzad pa ste/ /lam gyi rten dang lam dang 'bras bu la/ /'god mdzad 'gro kun thar lam 'dren pa'o/ /'di dag rnam grol 'bras bu'i mchog rab ste/ /'od gsal mthar thug mngon du gyur pa yin/ /theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ bsgom pa mthar phyin pa 'bras bu'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o// // de ltar mdo rgyud man ngag snying po'i don/ /skal bzang rnams kyis rab tu rtogs bya'i phyir/ /thos bsam bsgom pa'i rim pa ma nor ba/ /'khor 'das spang blang tshul gyis legs par bshad/ /tshul 'di blo gros yangs pa'i nam mkha' la/ /thos bsam bsgom pa'i chu 'dzin rab 'khrigs te/ /phan bde'i glog phreng 'brug sgra sgrogs pa las/ /rin chen chos char 'jig rten rgyan gyur brtsams/ /bsod nams ston ka'i zla rgyas dang 'dra bas/

/'gro kun chos dbyings dag pa'i nam mkha' la/ /shin tu mi g.yo zag med thugs rje'i lha/ / mgon po gangs chen mtshor gyur thob par shog /rab dge dri med gang des skye dgu'i tshogs/ /nyon mongs rnyog bral ye shes klu dbang gnas/ /zab yangs brtse sprin snying po dang ldan pa/ /mgon po mi 'khrugs mtsho chen thob par shog /yon tan tshogs mnga' mchog dge dri med kyis/ /tshogs gnyis las grub yon tan rdzogs pa'i gtso/ /srid zhi'i bde 'byung phan bde'i char 'bab pa/ /mgon po rin chen 'byor pa mtha' yas shog /dge ba 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /'chi bdag la sogs bdud bzhi rnam bcom ste/ /skye rga na 'chi'i mtsho chen las sgrol ba/ /mgon po tshe mtha' yas pa thob par shog /yid bzhin dge mchog rgya cher lhun mtho bas/ /'gro kun 'dod dgu'i re ba rdzogs pa'i dpal/ /phrin las mthar phyin dngos grub char 'bebs pa'i/ /mgon po don kun grub pa thob par shog /yid bzhin bsngo ba rgya chen gyur pa des/ /rang gzhan srid pa'i rgya mtsho las brgal nas/ /tshe rabs kun tu gzhan la phan brtson cing*/ /chos rnga bsgrags pas 'jig rten grags par shog /chos tshul 'di yang nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /phyogs kyi tha gru kun tu grags gyur te/ / blo gros padmo rab tu rgyas byed cing*/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par shog / theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba/ rang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa tshul khrims blo gros kyis legs par sbyar ba rdzogs so// //dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (13)theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod/ PAGE 66- - PAGE 67- -- PAGE 1 -
